jobs.description:
Job Description
The Program Director Program Director Digital Transformation is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving business process transformation across global operations through the successful design, implementation, adoption, and sustainment of enterprise systems and digital capabilities.
This leader serves as the primary bridge between Operations and Technology, ensuring business objectives are translated into scalable processes, system capabilities, and operating models that support growth, compliance, operational excellence, and organizational agility.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in manufacturing and operational processes, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Key Responsibilities
- Program Leadership: Lead Transformation across global manufacturing operations and functions, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and deliverables. Bridge business, process and technology to drive transformation and develop global, scalable processes.
- Business Process Excellence: Lead a cross functional team of Manufacturing, Planning, Quality, Warehouse, Finance and Engineering in the design and optimization of end-to-end processes to establish future-state business capabilities, governance, and process standards aligned to enterprise objectives and industry best practice. Facilitate cross-functional workshops and decision-making forums to establish aligned business processes and scalable operating practices.
- Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with IT, Finance, Global Operations COEs and other related functions to ensure solutions meet business objectives while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders to establish global process templates and governance models.
- Program Leadership & Execution: Oversee the planning and execution of global transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams, establishing effective governance, milestone tracking, and reporting to ensure transparent and reliable delivery. Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and organizational impacts, while driving alignment across interconnected enterprise initiatives and identifying opportunities to maximize business value and resources.
- Stakeholder Engagement, Change Management & Communication: Build strong partnerships with functional leaders, site leadership, IT teams, and executive stakeholders across regions and functions to drive alignment, engagement, and adoption of transformation initiatives. Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that support organizational readiness and business outcomes. Translate complex business, operational, and technical concepts into clear, actionable messages, and deliver executive presentations, steering committee updates, and transformation communications that drive informed decision-making and stakeholder commitment.
- Value Realization: Track realization of success metrics, ROI and operational benefits including productivity, quality, inventory optimization, service levels, compliance, and cost performance. Ensure decisions are data-driven and tied to measurable business outcomes.
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration or related field.
- 12+ years of progressive experience in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Transformation, or related disciplines.
- Proven leadership experience delivering large-scale ERP or enterprise transformation programs.
- Deep expertise in manufacturing operations, planning, supply chain, quality, or related operational processes.
- Demonstrated experience leading global cross-functional initiatives.
- Strong understanding of business process design, process governance, and operating model transformation.
- Exceptional communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
- Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate complex organizational dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ME, or related enterprise platforms.
- Experience implementing global process templates and standardized business models.
- Medical device, or regulated industry experience.
- Lean, Six Sigma, APICS, SCOR, or related certifications.

jobs.title: Academic Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Academic Ecosystem Strategy & Surgeon Pipeline Development​​​​​​
- Develop long-term academic marketing strategies to strengthen Intuitive’s leadership in robotic surgical education across Korea.
- Build structured surgeon development pathways from resident/fellow to Early Practice Surgeon and advanced robotic surgeon.
- Identify future growth opportunities through surgeon pipeline analysis, specialty trends,and academic ecosystem mapping.
- Support strategic alignment between academic initiatives and ISK commercial priorities.

Academic Hospital Partnership & Capability Building
- Partner with Tier 1(A) academic hospitals and regional training hospitals to establish scalable robotic surgery academic programs.
- Support hospitals in developing internal robotic surgery education systems, faculty engagement models, and learning infrastructures.
- Collaborate with hospital leadership to strengthen institutional commitment toward robotic training ecosystem development.
- Facilitate open-access and collaborative learning opportunities for emerging robotic surgeons.

Surgical Society & long term Credentialing Engagement
- Build strategic collaboration with surgical societies & academic to support robotic surgery education and credentialing initiatives.
- Support development of standardized learning pathways, training frameworks, and educational recognition programs in collaboration with societies.
- Monitor healthcare policy and reimbursement trends related to robotic surgery training and credentialing environments.
- Coordinate cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment between academic strategy and clinical/commercial objectives.

Residency / Fellowship / Early practice surgeon Program Development
- Develop differentiated academic initiatives targeting residents, fellows, and Early Practice Surgeons.
- Support transition pathways from formal training programs into independent robotic surgical practice.
- Collaborate with customer training team to enhance training readiness, surgeon confi dence, and procedural adoption.
- Support development of future robotic surgery educators and emerging KOLs.

Lead Educator & Faculty Development
- Identify and support development of hospital-based robotic surgery lead educators and B. Facilitate Train-the-Trainer (TTT) initiatives and scalable faculty engagement models.
- Strengthen peer-to-peer learning ecosystems through academic collaboration and faculty networking.

Academic Program Execution & Ecosystem Integration
- Lead planning and execution of academic programs, workshops, symposiums, educational collaborations, and ecosystem initiatives.
- Integrate digital learning, Training equivalency platforms, and data-driven educational tools into academic marketing strategies.
- Collaborate with Marketing, Clinical Education, Sales, Compliance, and Global/Regional teams to maximize program effectiveness and alignment.

Core Competencies & Skills
- Strong understanding of academic hospital dynamics and healthcare ecosystem decision-making structures.
- Capability to influence multiple stakeholders including hospital executives, surgical faculty, and society leaders.
- Strategic thinking with ability to balance academic value creation, market development, and business impact.
- Passion for developing next-generation robotic surgeons and advancing surgical education ecosystems.
Qualifications & Experience
- 7+ Years of relevant experience in healthcare industry (medical device experience preferred). Experience working with academic hospitals, residency/fellowship programs, or surgical societies strongly preferred.
- Understanding of Korea healthcare policy environment and robotic surgery market dynamics preferred.
- Experience in healthcare ecosystem development, medical education, or strategic stakeholder engagement is highly desirable.
- Proven track record in commercials roles in healthcare industry with a good understanding of healthcare/HCP compliance.
- Familiarity with the robotic surgery ecosystem and/or SP platform is a plu
- Ability to leverage digital platforms, data insights, and scalable learning models to enhance academic engagement and training effectiveness.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, collaboration tools (Zoom, Smartsheet), and data analysis platforms.

jobs.title: Hospital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Develop, lead and implement hospital marketing programs to drive technology adoption for prioritized customers.

Hospital Marketing Manager will have a critical role within the organization driving marketing strategies and enabling commercial teams to drive executive awareness, conversion, and advocacy for Intuitive.

This position will be responsible for development and coordination of various strategic and tactical hospital marketing initiatives. The individual will develop and scale best-in-class marketing assets, programs and standards to promote the value of Intuitive to executives and care teams across focus geographies. The role requires close collaboration with internal Intuitive stakeholders including other marketing departments, capital and clinical sales, training, clinical affairs, legal, regulatory, and compliance to execute key initiatives such as:
- Engage in market research activities for lead generation.
- Programmatic approach to developing deeper executive partnerships.
- Market development to accelerate technology adoption in focus markets.

The individual is expected to operate in a fast-paced environment as a marketing expert leading programs, tool creation and programmatic market development.

Roles and Responsibilities
- Robotic Assisted Surgery(RAS) Value Proposition to C-Suites and Care Teams - Support Technology Expansion: Develop and execute a strong awareness and activation plan for enabling key executive champions in target accounts in focus geographies to advance dV surgery adoption.
- Support Programmatic Excellence in RAS through best-in-class practices observation, amplification and implementation across different accounts.
- Peer-to-Peer Programs: Scale assets and programs established for executive value discussions such as peer to peer advocacy channels, webinars, and reference site visits.

- Sales Enablement - Collaborate with the capital sales to ensure sales teams master the articulation of value messages, overcoming objections and provide impactful customer experiences.
- Understand the promotion and messaging asset needs of sales teams and build these high impact sales enablement assets such as Reference selling toolkits, Executive profiles, success case studies, data driven dashboards, presentations, brochures, videos and handouts.

- Enable and develop Robotic Health Care Ecosystem - Establish surgeon, care team, surgical center and ongoing relationships with the goal of making ISI the preferred industry partner for intelligent surgical care delivery.
- Support the economic value of Clinical Evidence generation -

- Marketing Capabilities: - Co-create the content and amplify the best-in-class practices for successfully running a robotic program
- Account level Data-dashboards for Executive level decision making
- Support advocacy events with Executives and care team members
- Cross functional collaboration and alignment

- Competitive Intelligence · - Lead the competitive intelligence function by monitoring market dynamics, competitor strategies, emerging technologies, and commercial trends to inform business decisions.
- Develop actionable insights through competitor benchmarking, win-loss analysis, pricing intelligence, and market research to strengthen commercial strategy.
- Translate market intelligence into strategic recommendations that influence portfolio planning, product positioning, customer engagement, and long-term growth priorities.
- Establish a regular executive intelligence cadence, delivering insights and strategic implications to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.

- Ecosystem Marketing - Develop and execute ecosystem marketing strategies that strengthen partnerships across healthcare providers, professional societies, digital health organizations, policymakers, and industry stakeholders.
- Build strategic collaborations that enhance brand credibility, accelerate market development, and expand access to innovation across the healthcare ecosystem.
- Drive integrated stakeholder engagement initiatives that position the organization as a trusted thought leader and long-term partner in advancing healthcare transformation.
- Identify and cultivate new ecosystem opportunities that support commercial growth, advocacy development, and sustainable market expansion
- Education - MBA from a premier/tier 1 institute in India or abroad.
- Experience - 6 - 8 years of total experience with minimum 3 years of marketing experience in a medical device, surgical or Pharma Company. Surgical and/or OR experience desired.

- Proven ability to effectively position and message products/procedures and implement marketing programs to drive product/procedure adoption.
- Demonstrated ability to work creatively amidst competing priorities to deliver high-impact marketing programs on-time and within budget to support overall marketing strategy and business objectives.
- Results-driven attitude & a resolve to win
- Entrepreneurial, collaborative, strategic thinker with excellent project management skills and ability to prioritize and plan.
- Excellent interpersonal skills with emphasis on leadership, relationship development and influence management.
- Proven ability to solve open-ended problems and work cross-functionally to implement initiatives.
- Superior verbal/written communication and presentation skills, teambuilding, and interpersonal skills to work across multiple constituents.

- Ability to travel - Up to 60%. Some international travel may be required

jobs.title: Product Portfolio & Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
As a member of the UK & Ireland Marketing team, the primary functions of the Product Portfolio & Digital Marketing Manager role are to lead on the development, implementation and execution of marketing strategies and tactics for the Product and Digital portfolios.  The product portfolio will include da Vinci systems, Advanced Technologies, Instruments and Accessories and Digital Solutions including Intuitive Hub, My Intuitive and SIMNOW.
You will be responsible for developing value messaging, KOL development and scaling the success of existing and newly launched products while accelerating the adoption of Intuitive’s product and digital portfolios across the UK and Ireland. This position will work collaboratively with UKI and EU marketing, sales and ecosystem functions to drive utilization in targeted procedures for both portfolios.
You will have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills that will drive a collaborative and adaptable approach across business functions to execute on the commercial strategies.
Roles and Responsibilities:
- Build and leverage product management skillsets to manage the existing da Vinci Systems, Advanced Technology, I&A and Digital portfolios.
- Create go-to-market strategies for new products within multiple surgical specialties through close collaboration with the Clinical Marketing, Sales leadership and Training teams on launch strategies and tactics to increase utilization.
- Integrate the digital portfolio into the commercial teams, to drive awareness and adoption of the entire Intuitive Ecosystem in alignment with business goals.
- Engage key customers to create and develop reference centers to accelerate technology adoption and utilization of da Vinci systems, Advanced Technologies and Digital solutions.
- Create clinical and economic reference stories (QTIs) and marketing collateral that articulates the value proposition associated with Intuitive’s technologies.
- Develop analytical, scalable tools to monitor the portfolio, competition, and opportunities, in collaboration with the Sales Operations Team, to leverage data that informs marketing and sales strategies and opportunities.

- Identify and develop Product Champions for existing and newly launched products across surgical specialties.
- Collaborate with Key Opinion Leaders and European Product Marketing to develop localized value propositions and messaging for Intuitive’s technologies.
- Partner with European and Regional Marketing and Sales at conferences and tradeshows, Executive Education Events, Market Development Events, and Key Customer events, to deliver impactful product demonstrations (test-drives), technology presentations, and ensure the key product messaging is included in Intuitive-sponsored presentations and customer interactions.
- Grow Energy and Stapling utilization across the UK and Ireland and support sales by implementing new sales tools and collateral.
- Develop and maintain procedural knowledge and key surgeon relationships by attending cases and collaborating with Regional and EU Marketing.

- Bachelor’s degree in life science or business discipline.
- Chartered Institute of Marketing or Advanced Diploma preferred.
- 8+ year’s experience within a medical device or therapeutic company.
- 4+ years of Clinical/Product marketing experience within a medical device or therapeutic company.
- Proven ability to effectively position, launch and message product/procedure.
- Demonstrated ability to work creatively, prioritize and smoothly manage goals and initiatives with competing priorities.
- Strong commercial acumen to drive product adoption.
- Self-starter with ability to problem solve and establish solutions in a high-growth and fast-paced environment.
- Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills in English.
- Strong interpersonal skills across multiple constituents.
- A keen ability to manage projects, keeping budgeting, organizing, prioritizing and coping with multiple tasks.
- Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite.
- Ability to travel 20-30%. International travel required.
- The role will be based in Winnersh with office days on Tue, Wed & Thu.

jobs.title: Clinical Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of the Position
This position is responsible for the development and execution of tactical clinical marketing initiatives to drive da Vinci procedure adoption across prioritized specialties and focus procedures in India. The role partners closely with commercial teams to translate market insights into programs that drive surgeon awareness, dV utilization, and advocacy.
The individual will lead market understanding through field immersion, customer insight generation, segmentation, persona development, and value messaging. This role is expected to build scalable clinical marketing programs and assets, collaborate with external surgeons, society leaders, and care teams, and work cross-functionally with sales, training, clinical affairs, market access, legal, regulatory, and compliance to deliver measurable business impact in a fast-paced environment.
Essential Job Duties
Robotic Assisted Surgery (RAS) Value Proposition
- Identify, develop, and engage surgeon champions and key opinion leaders who can articulate compelling clinical, economic, and operational value messages to advance da Vinci adoption.
- Design and scale peer-to-peer programs, case observation opportunities, proctorships, webinars, workshops, and educational pathways.
- Develop and execute engagement plans for key specialty societies, conferences, symposia, and academic forums to strengthen Intuitive’s clinical presence and influence.
- Translate global best practices into locally relevant programs, tools, and content that support procedural growth and long-term market development.

Sales Enablement
- Partner with commercial learning and sales teams to strengthen articulation of procedure value, objection handling, and customer engagement across target segments.
- Develop high-impact sales enablement tools including presentations, brochures, digital content, videos, handouts, and clinical playbooks that support adoption conversations.
- Collaborate with regional and global marketing teams to localize and amplify clinical marketing messages, campaigns, and assets.

Enable and develop dV Ecosystem
- Spend time in the field with customers and sales teams to understand specialty-specific insights. Leverage these insights to build a robust dV RAS ecosystem.
- Build strong relationships with surgeons, care teams, and health system stakeholders to position Intuitive as a trusted partner in intelligent surgical care delivery.
- Support the generation and dissemination of clinical and economic evidence in partnership with market access, clinical affairs, and other functions to reinforce value-based adoption.

Marketing Capabilities:
- Use qualitative and quantitative analysis to understand market and procedure trends – integrate these trends to build and modify strategy.
- Support or lead new procedure and product introductions, including readiness planning, launch execution, and post-launch optimization.
- Guide digital and omnichannel clinical marketing engagement across web, email, social, and field channels for physician, patient, and provider audiences, where applicable.
- Drive strong cross-functional collaboration and disciplined execution across sales, training, medical, regulatory, legal, and compliance stakeholders.
Required Skills and Experience
- More than 5 years of total experience in sales and/or marketing function in a medical device, or healthcare environment.
- Strong understanding of healthcare ecosystems, surgical procedures, and customer journeys, with proven ability to translate insights into adoption-focused marketing programs.
- Demonstrated strength in strategic thinking, project management, prioritization, and execution in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders and build long-term relationships.
- Ability to travel extensively within India; international travel may be required.

Required Education and Training
- Bachelor’s degree required; degree in life sciences, healthcare, analytics or a related field is preferred.
- MBA or other advanced degree is preferred.

jobs.title: Sr Compensation Business Partner
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
This position is a senior member of the Compensation Business Partner team, reporting to the Director, Global Compensation. The Sr Compensation Partner serves as a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders, translating business priorities into practical, market-informed compensation strategies and solutions for assigned global client groups, currently including Manufacturing, Future Forward, and the Chief Medical Office. This role requires a deep understanding of each organization’s business model, talent strategy, and workforce needs, with the ability to apply compensation philosophy, market intelligence, internal equity, and governance principles to support sound decision-making.
This position will also contribute to compensation program development, which includes annual salary structure design, compensation planning, equity programs, executive compensation, and other enterprise compensation initiatives. In partnership with HR business leaders and partners, this role will communicate, train, and deliver compensation programs to aligned client groups. The incumbent will lead and consult on complex HR and Compensation-related projects, develop executive-ready recommendations, frame tradeoffs, and influence leaders at all levels. As an active member of the corporate compensation team, this individual will provide support, mentorship, and guidance to other team members as well.
Roles & Responsibilities:
- Develop a deep understanding of Intuitive’s business models, talent priorities, and workforce strategies to develop practical, business-aligned compensation solutions that support talent attraction, retention, performance, and internal equity
- Develop executive-ready analysis, recommendations, and decision support materials that clearly frame business context, compensation considerations, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended actions
- Design, enhance, and scale compensation programs, processes, tools, and frameworks that address complex business needs and improve enterprise scalability
- Serve as a credible Compensation advisor, influencing and advising HR and business leaders across assigned client groups
- Monitor emerging compensation trends and market practices to provide expert consulting on base salary, variable pay, equity, retention, offers, promotions, and organizational design decisions
- Evaluate current and proposed base pay, variable pay, and equity program design for alignment to established guidelines, compensation philosophy, job architecture, market data, internal equity, and policy guardrails
- Provide timely, consultative support on emerging business needs and develop scalable approaches where recurring needs are identified
- Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve compensation analysis, workflow efficiency, communications, and executive-ready deliverables while maintaining human review, data privacy, confidentiality, and sound business judgment
- Coach and mentor Compensation team members by sharing methodologies, best practices, and practical guidance on complex compensation matters
Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:
- Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Finance, or related field preferred; 12+ years of relevant compensation, Total Rewards, HR, or business advisory experience
- Deep knowledge of competitive market pay practices, compensation program design, job architecture, internal equity, compensation governance, pay equity considerations, regulatory requirements, and confidentiality expectations, with strong external networking skills
- Robust analytical skills and business acumen, with the ability to assess implications of actual and planned activities and translate insights into practical recommendations that add value to management decisions
- Advanced Excel and analytical modeling skills, with the ability to synthesize large data sets into clear insights, recommendations, and decision-ready materials
- Foundational AI literacy and ability to use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, process efficiency, and communication quality while maintaining ownership of final recommendations and business judgment
- Proven team orientation with a collaborative style, flexible demeanor, and ability to balance detailed execution with a broader enterprise perspective
- Demonstrated ability to work efficiently under conditions of multiple deadlines and changing priorities to produce a large volume of high-quality material with meticulous attention to detail
- Strong influencing skills with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently when advising senior leaders
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with advanced problem-solving orientation, sound judgment, and proven ability to develop, present, and justify recommendations to all levels within the company
- Independent self-starter with the ability to successfully manage multiple priorities and navigate ambiguity in a sophisticated matrix structure

**Please note this role requires being onsite three days per week in either our Sunnyvale, CA or Peachtree Corners, GA office.
Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

jobs.title: Sr Endoluminal Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Sr. Endoluminal Marketing Manager drives adoption of the Ion Endoluminal system by developing and executing marketing strategies for Ion robotic-assisted bronchoscopy solutions across Korea. This role leads the Intuitive Thoracic Oncology and lung care strategy from building marketing plans with key stakeholders to establishing metrics that measure their impact.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and creative thinker who thrives on rolling up their sleeves to strengthen hospital relationships, engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and foster alignment across the commercial team through clinical education and Intuitive technology awareness programs.

Essential Job Duties
Marketing Strategy & Business Planning
- Develop and execute the annual Ion marketing plan and Total Lung Care strategy, translating business objectives into actionable initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.
- Develop a deep understanding of target customer personas and identify compelling clinical, economic, and operational value propositions for each stakeholder group.
- Generate market insights and leverage customer, competitive, and business data to inform strategy and prioritize opportunities.
- Enhance Ion QTI (Quantify the Impact) models by incorporating clinical and financial outcomes data to demonstrate customer value and support adoption decisions.
- Establish success metrics and regularly evaluate program effectiveness to optimize performance and scalability.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment
- Lead collaboration across Ion Clinical Marketing, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Patient Marketing, Commercial teams, Business Operations, and Korea Leadership Team to ensure alignment on strategic priorities.
- Partner closely with APAC regional teams and global stakeholders to adapt and execute initiatives that support both regional and local business objectives.
- Align stakeholders around integrated marketing plans and customer engagement strategies that effectively communicate Intuitive's value proposition.
- Drive execution through influence and collaboration in a highly matrixed organization.

Commercial Marketing & Program Execution
- Lead the design and execution of high-impact marketing programs, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and aligned with overall business goals.
- Develop integrated campaigns, educational initiatives, and customer-facing resources that strengthen awareness, belief, and adoption of Ion and Intuitive's thoracic oncology solutions.
- Partner with GAVE (Global Access, Value, and Economics), Clinical Affairs, and other internal stakeholders to support clinical research, health economic studies, publications, and related evidence-generation initiatives.
- Collaborate with da Vinci Thoracic Surgery Marketing and other relevant teams to advance Intuitive's broader thoracic oncology strategy and customer engagement approach.
- Develop and manage marketing collateral and resources that support commercial execution while ensuring compliance with Legal, Regulatory, and Clinical Affairs requirements.
- Manage agency and vendor relationships to maximize program effectiveness and execution quality.

KOL & Customer Engagement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare providers, and strategic customers to support advocacy, education, and technology adoption.
- Partner with Korea Marketing and Commercial Leadership to identify, develop, and engage influential physicians and surgeons through Intuitive-sponsored educational programs, peer-to-peer engagements, and observational experiences.
- Promote awareness of Intuitive's clinical vision, educational philosophy, and innovation approach within the thoracic oncology community.
- Gather customer insights and market feedback to continuously refine marketing strategies, messaging, and customer engagement approaches.
Required Skills and Experience
- Minimum Bachelor’s degree required
- Minimum of 8 years of combined experience, primarily in marketing, with exposure to sales, commercial, or key account management. Healthcare industry background preferred
- Experience in medical/surgical devices and robotics, broncho suite, or operating room is heavily preferred
- Strong storyteller with proven ability to make meaningful connections between target markets, customer needs and the impact of Intuitive's solutions in a differentiated way
- Clinical acumen in lung health specialties is preferred
- Experience with Marketing Automation, CRM (Salesforce.com), Google Analytics and Tableau
- Proven ability to work successfully in a matrixed organization and successfully manage internal and external stakeholders
- Prior experience working with and managing agencies on marketing programs is preferred
- Excellent interpersonal skills with emphasis on leadership, relationship development and influence management
- Superior verbal/written communication and presentation skills, team building, and interpersonal skills both in Korean and English
- Skilled in mentoring and coaching colleagues
- Regional travel to include national trips as needed. Ability to travel up to 40%

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
A da Vinci Area Sales Manager is responsible for selling the daVinci™ Surgical System to greenfield hospitals and existing hospitals within the Area Sales Manager’s assigned territory. This requires a number of capabilities including expert-level knowledge in the use of surgical robotics, the ability to build a team of advocates within each hospital, strong solution selling skills, and enough tenacity to ensure sales objectives are met on a consistent basis. Da Vinci Area Sales Managers are expected to provide an extraordinary degree of information gathering and presenting to buying teams throughout the capital equipment purchasing process.
Roles and Responsibilities:
This position has responsibility and authority for:
- Manage the complex sales process of daVinci Surgical Systems into new hospitals and upgrades into existing hospitals.
- Build clinical and administrative support through technical presentations, executive meetings, marketing events and system test drives.
- Build support from surgeons and administration for da Vinci® Surgery.
- Identify key institutions, generate market awareness, and drive sales of the daVinci™ Surgical System within an assigned sales territory.
- Effectively manage transition of initial sale and installation to the clinical sales team to drive procedural volume and growth.
- Achieve quarterly sales targets.
- Partner with the da Vinci Area Sales Director to develop a sales plan for their local territory.
- Build surgical advocacy teams at each hospital.
- Develop initial contact with CEO and senior hospital administrators.
- Organize and manage the sales process.
- Develop expert level knowledge of primary OR procedures.
- Make business case for system purchase.
- Resolve contractual issues and coordinate system installation upon purchase approval.
- Handle all communications and administrative follow-up.
- Collaborate with team members across the Intuitive commercial organization to develop people, processes, and pipeline opportunities.
- Implement strategies for early-stage new product launches that accelerate procedures and capital placements.
- Develop general executive development activities (round tables, executive sessions, etc.).
- Participate in designing QTI, BAM content and defining approach with targeted customers
- Active involvement in weekly and quarterly sales planning process for the dedicated territory.
- Manage expenses within budget.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
- Minimum of 5 years’ sales experience preference for experience in healthcare or capital sales.
- Knowledge of the operating room environment.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proven successful project management.
- Proven successful track record in capital medical equipment sales.
- Proven track record of high performance and collaboration in various sales roles.
- Strong Account Management and Value Selling.
- Demonstrate collaborative leadership and influence management.
- Foster creative solutions and idea sharing for common problems.
- Ability to travel up to 80%, dependent upon account distribution.
- Fluent in English and local language as required.

- Sales management experience a plus.

jobs.title: IT Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position
The IT Sourcing Manager is responsible for leading sourcing initiatives across Intuitive's Information Technology spend categories, including Software/SaaS, Cloud, Hardware, Telecommunications, and Technology Services. This role partners with IT, Finance, Contracts COE, Security, Privacy, and business stakeholders to execute sourcing strategies that optimize cost, mitigate risk, and deliver measurable business value.
The IT Sourcing Manager independently manages sourcing and contracting activities throughout the procurement lifecycle, including spend analysis, supplier and market research, RFx execution, negotiations, business case development, contract management support, and supplier performance management. This individual will lead multiple sourcing initiatives simultaneously and support category management objectives across assigned technology spend categories.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical, negotiation, project management, and communication skills who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Organization Overview
This role reports to the Director, Technology Sourcing within the Strategic Sourcing & Category Management team, a key function of Intuitive's Global Enterprise Procurement (GEP) organization.
The Technology Sourcing team supports technology and IT procurement requirements across Intuitive's global operations and is organized to provide deep expertise across the following categories:
- Cloud, AI & Emerging Technologies

- Cybersecurity

- Network & Infrastructure

- Software & SaaS

- Telecommunications & Connectivity

- Technology Services & Outsourcing

The IT Sourcing Manager will support one or more of these categories and collaborate across the broader Technology Sourcing team to drive sourcing, contracting, supplier management, and category management initiatives.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Strategic Sourcing
- Lead sourcing initiatives across assigned IT categories, including Software/SaaS, Cloud, Hardware, Telecommunications, and Technology Services.

- Independently manage RFx and sourcing activities from initiation through contract execution for low-to-high complexity projects.

- Conduct supplier assessments, market intelligence research, benchmarking, and spend analysis to identify sourcing opportunities and support business decision-making.

- Develop sourcing strategies, business cases, negotiation plans, and award recommendations that align with stakeholder objectives.

- Analyze supplier proposals and commercial models, including pricing, licensing structures, total cost of ownership, and associated business risks.

- Facilitate supplier selection activities and drive alignment among cross-functional stakeholders.

- Lead sourcing project meetings and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and communication plans.

- Support category strategy initiatives by providing market intelligence, supplier insights, spend analysis, and sourcing recommendations.

Contract Negotiation and Commercial Management
- Lead commercial negotiations for technology agreements, including software, SaaS, cloud, hardware, maintenance, professional services, and telecommunications contracts.

- Partner with Contracts COE, Security, Privacy, Finance, and business stakeholders to negotiate favorable commercial terms while mitigating risk to the company.

- Evaluate contractual obligations, pricing structures, service levels, and business requirements to identify opportunities for optimization.

- Support contract renewals, supplier consolidations, competitive sourcing events, and commercial restructuring initiatives.

- Ensure sourcing activities comply with company policies, procurement procedures, and governance requirements.

- Assist stakeholders in evaluating supplier proposals and contract alternatives to support informed decision-making.

Supplier and Category Management
- Support supplier relationship management activities for strategic and preferred suppliers.

- Participate in executive business reviews and supplier performance discussions.

- Monitor supplier performance metrics and assist in identifying and addressing service, quality, delivery, and commercial concerns.

- Conduct supplier risk assessments and escalate potential risks to management and stakeholders as appropriate.

- Support category management initiatives through spend analytics, market trend analysis, supplier segmentation, and opportunity identification.

- Collaborate with IT portfolio owners and business stakeholders to execute sourcing plans and category initiatives.

Analytics and Business Support
- Develop spend analysis, supplier benchmarking, cost models, savings analyses, and business cases to support sourcing recommendations.

- Prepare executive-level presentations, sourcing summaries, negotiation updates, and stakeholder communications.

- Track sourcing project status, value delivery, savings achievement, and key performance metrics.

- Support annual sourcing roadmaps, budget planning, and category planning activities.

- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance sourcing effectiveness, stakeholder experience, and procurement processes.

- Provide support for ad hoc sourcing, contracting, and supplier-related requests.
Required Skills and Experience
- Bachelor's Degree required; Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Systems, or related discipline preferred.

- 6+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years supporting IT strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, vendor management, or technology contract negotiations.

- Experience sourcing and negotiating across multiple IT spend categories, including Software/SaaS, Cloud, Hardware, Telecommunications, or Technology Services.

- Knowledge of software licensing models, cloud consumption-based pricing, and technology supplier management practices.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather data, perform financial analysis, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.

- Demonstrated ability to lead sourcing projects and drive results through cross-functional collaboration.

- Experience conducting supplier evaluations, market research, benchmarking, and competitive sourcing events.

- Strong contract and commercial negotiation skills.

- Ability to influence stakeholders and build consensus across multiple functions and organizational levels.

- Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating in a team environment.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving business environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working in a regulated industry or global organization.

- Familiarity with procurement, contract lifecycle management, P2P, ERP, and spend analytics tools.

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position
The Manager, People Services leads a geographically distributed team supporting People Services Tier 2 operations across the Americas region. This role oversees HR operations, Workday administration, process improvement initiatives, project management activities, and employee lifecycle support. The position requires Workday experience with a strong understanding of business processes, data governance, and downstream impacts across  teams, projects, and integrated systems. This leader drives operational excellence, develops organizational capability, and partners cross-functionally to deliver scalable, compliant, and employee-centric services.
Essential Job Duties
- Lead, develop, and oversee the performance, training, and professional growth of teams in the U.S. and Mexicali.

- Serve as Workday SME for complex transactions, audits, corrections, and troubleshooting.

- Drive data integrity and quality assurance activities.

- Lead HR operational and system-related projects.

- Manage escalations and partner cross-functionally with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Legal, Recruiting, and IT.

- Develop SOPs, training materials, and governance practices.

- Coach and support team members on Workday, project management, and HR operations.

Area Sales Manager is responsible for selling the daVinci™ Surgical System to hospitals within the assigned territory. This requires a number of capabilities including expert-level knowledge in the use of surgical robotics, the ability to build a team of advocates within each hospital, strong solution-selling skills, and enough tenacity to ensure sales objectives are met on a consistent basis. Area Sales Managers are expected to provide an extraordinary degree of information gathering and presenting to buying teams throughout the capital equipment purchasing process

- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills in both the Korean and English command

- Knowledge of the operating room environment preferred

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
This position will implement and execute marketing programs for the Region and drive adoption and growth of da Vinci  surgical procedures. The focus will be in the specialties of Urology and Gynaecology, together with responsibility for marketing activities relating to da Vinci Single Port.  The Marketing Manager is also expected to work with a cross-functional regional sales and training team, working closely with the European marketing group as well as other departments including Medical Affairs, Clinical Affairs, FSO, GPA, GAVE and MACA.
The primary function of this position is to be able to execute the following global marketing standards at a country/regional level:
- Understand your market – Open/MIS rate, National outcomes, surgeon/patient/hospital segments, reimbursement levels, incumbent surgical techniques and KOLs etc.
- Maintain alignment on target procedures/products – Help define what is being driven and why within commercial org and keep all teams focused on this “commercial strategy”.
- Build Value Props Stories, Tools, Events and Engage 3Ps (Physician, Patient, Provider) with them - targeted in the right sequence.
- Develop Speaker/Teacher /Executive KOLs – with strong technique, outcomes, and use of advanced technology.
- Quantify the impact (QTI) – clinical, economic, strategic evidence - of key daVinci surgeons/hospitals as references.
- Align with relevant Surgical and Executive societies on daVinci surgery to ensure support and partnership.

Roles and Responsibilities :
Understand your market
- Develop and execute regional/country marketing tactics. This will include detailed activities to be implemented in a defined timeline and budget, strong collaboration with the European marketing team and local sales leadership.
- Strong partnering with clinical and capital sales teams in a growing competitive environment for analysis, targeting and regional action planning purposes.

Maintain alignment on target procedures/products
- Work closely with Market Access and Clinical Affairs to develop and implement publication strategies that will support procedure adoption goals.
- Collaborate with Training department to identify and support the development of regional sales team. Deliver content for regional company meetings.

Build Value Props Stories, Tools, Events and Engage 3Ps
- Deliver corporate clinical & capital marketing and sales tools to achieve short and long-term goals for procedures /sales quotas, products, and system sales Develop Speaker/Teacher/ /Executive KOLs.
- Partner with key surgeon champions (KOLs) to develop and implement leading robotic clinical education programs and symposia to drive competency and utilization of da Vinci Ò Surgery.
- Develop and approve proctors based on surgical, clinical, and teaching expertise to implement safe and effective reproducible surgical techniques with improve clinical outcomes.

Quantify the impact (QTI) – Clinical, economic, strategic evidence
- Work closely with the Regional MACA team to assist in development and execution of cost effectiveness/ value strategies in key markets.

- Collect, analyse, and share competitive data for strategic positioning and initiatives.
- Validate Clinical and Economical data with reference case observation center, key surgeon champions (KOLs) and proctors.

Align with relevant Surgical and Executive societies
- Develop and implement Intuitive’s presence at key national conferences, including robotics symposia, postgraduate (PG) courses, live surgical broadcasts, tradeshow booth promotion and presence.
- Develop and implement impactful training curriculae in collaboration with relevant societies with a strong focus on General Surgery.

Coach other Marketing colleagues in on-boarding, learning marketing standards, and growing their business acumen (clinical, hospital, or academic).
Lead cross-functional teams to deliver high value marketing projects and programs.
Deliver impactful presentations to senior and executive Intuitive leadership.
Be a champion of the Intuitive culture; learning and embodying the company’s individual expectations for success.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience :
- Clinical/Sales and/or Product marketing experience in a therapeutic medical device company, Gynaecology or Urology surgery experience is beneficial.
- Surgical and/or Operating Theatre (Room) sales experience preferred.
- Proven ability to effectively position and procedure/product messages and develop strong sales support to drive desired adoption.
- Demonstrated success in building clinical education and marketing programs to drive product/procedure growth.
- Language (spoken and written): fluency in English and at least one Nordic language
- Bachelor's degree in life science or business discipline.
- Superior verbal/written communication, teamwork, and interpersonal work across multiple constituents.
- Self-starter with ability to take leadership in unstructured environment.
- A keen ability to manage projects, keeping to budget, organizing, prioritizing and coping with multiple tasks.
- Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite.
- Ability to travel 70%. International travel required.

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position
- Manages supply chain of assigned direct materials suppliers and parts to support business continuity and optimization, including sourcing, development of category strategy roadmaps, negotiating contracts, analyzing spend, creating inventory management strategies, gathering commodity intelligence, and managing supplier performance; may include limited management of purchase orders.

- Leads cross-functional category team(s)

- Identifies and may implement key Global Supply Chain initiatives

Essential Job Duties
- Category Management for electronics categories - wiring harness, electronics assemblies and OEM parts
- Provides cross-functional team leadership within assigned category(ies); leads cross-functional category team meetings

- Collaborates with manager and cross-functional peers to create long-term supplier strategies and roadmaps. Engages with internal stakeholders to develop and influence category strategy that aligns with long-term business objectives.

- Co-leads direct procurement supplier selection process with collaboration from Supplier Engineering and guidance from manager. Leverages knowledge of strategic sourcing practices to identify a core supply base able to offer lowest total cost of ownership and high-quality product while identifying value improvement opportunities.

- Develops and presents category strategy reviews

- Proactively collaborates with supply base and procurement team to understand and communicate demand changes and minimize excess inventory or material shortages

- Escalates issues with supplier executive leadership with support and guidance of manager

- Develops mitigation plans and programs for assigned suppliers and critical sub-tier suppliers; collaborates with manager and cross-functional peers to drive implementation

- Leads capacity assessments for assigned suppliers and critical sub-tier suppliers; anticipates long-term risks and installs proactive mitigations

- May serve as project manager for key supplier capacity or risk mitigation initiatives

- Leverages problem solving skills and develops counter-measures to implement long-term solutions to identified problems

- Establishes contractual agreements with suppliers and amendments to existing agreements

- Negotiates long-term volume pricing, risk mitigation, and capacity agreements with key suppliers to support Intuitive’s volume growth

- Leads identification and implementation of cost reduction ideas to achieve year-over-year cost goals within assigned category(ies)

- May lead change management/change order implementation for complex projects

- Supports master data integrity for suppliers and parts

- Mentors colleagues within the supply chain organization. Identifies process and training improvement opportunities and drives closure of identified gaps.

- Experience utilizing strategic sourcing principles, including six step sourcing process, category strategy development, and collaborative supplier management

- Strong negotiation skills, proven track record of savings, and thorough understanding of key supplier agreement terms

- Proven track record of effective project management in a fast-paced manufacturing company. Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects successfully and adapt to changing priorities.

- Thorough knowledge of and experience working with kanban systems and other lean principles

- Working knowledge of buying, material planning, master scheduling, and forecasting

- Demonstrates concern for precision and thoroughness

- Proven ability to consistently achieve stretch goals and objectives

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Required Education and Training
- BS degree or equivalent and 10+ years of supply chain experience in a regulated industry manufacturing environment. Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Product Portfolio Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
The Senior Product Portfolio Marketing Manager is responsible for leading the commercialization of the Multiport portfolio across Europe, spanning da Vinci X, Xi, and da Vinci 5. The role develops and executes portfolio, marketing and sales strategies that drive adoption, support business growth, and strengthen portfolio positioning across customer segments.
The position is responsible for the successful lifecycle management of existing Multiport platforms while preparing the region for future platform launches and upgrades, ensuring Intuitive can offer the right portfolio solution to customers across Europe.
This role works closely with European and Global Marketing, Customer Training, Commercial Learning, Sales, and Operations teams to drive portfolio utilization and commercial success across targeted procedures and specialties.
Roles and Responsibilities:
- Lead portfolio positioning and differentiation strategies across the Multiport portfolio including da Vinci X, Xi and da Vinci 5, ensuring clear customer segmentation and platform positioning based on procedural needs, hospital profile and economic value.
- Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, software releases, platform upgrades and portfolio initiatives, partnering with European and Global Marketing, Sales, Customer Training, Commercial Learning, and other cross-functional teams to drive adoption and utilization.
- Develop and evolve the Multiport value proposition, translating clinical, operational and economic outcomes into compelling customer messaging and sales enablement tools.
- Lead the European commercialization of the Multiport value proposition, translating clinical, operational, and economic outcomes into compelling customer messaging and sales enablement tools.
- Develop and maintain procedural expertise and strategic surgeon relationships through case attendance and collaboration with Clinical and Country Marketing teams to inform portfolio strategy, commercialization plans and customer value messaging.
- Partner with Global Marketing and EU Marketing Operations to support portfolio planning, lifecycle management, product availability and end-of-life strategies.
- Develop analytical and scalable tools to monitor portfolio performance, competitive dynamics, market opportunities and commercialization effectiveness, and translate insights into recommended actions.
- Develop and leverage European reference centers demonstrating the clinical, operational and economic value of the Multiport portfolio across different customer segments, hospital profiles and procedure mix.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree required.
- Minimum of 7 years’ experience in sales or marketing within a medical device, surgical technology or therapeutic company.
- Experience in capital medical devices, surgical technologies, robotics, digital healthcare solutions, or healthcare technology commercialization strongly preferred.
- Proven ability to develop portfolio positioning, value propositions, commercialization strategies, and successful product launches.
- Strong commercial and analytical acumen, with the ability to translate market and customer insights into portfolio strategy and actions that drive adoption.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and competing priorities in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
- Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop and implement solutions.
- Demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams within a matrix organization.
- Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills in English.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to work with AI tools to increase efficiency.
- The job holder should be based in Aubonne, Switzerland, or Freiburg, Germany.
- Ability to travel up to 40%.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Primary function of Position
The manager, New Products (NPI) Supply Chain/Sourcing is a critical leadership role that leads the team that oversees supply chain operations for the launch of new products. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence by collaborating with cross-functional teams, optimizing processes, and ensuring timely, cost-effective supply of innovative products to market.

The Manager, New Products Supply Chain, will lead end-to-end supply chain activities for new product introduction (NPI) initiatives, driving innovation, speed-to-market, and operational excellence within a highly regulated industry. This manager will oversee sourcing, procurement, and supplier management activities for new product components and assemblies.
Responsibilities include building cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory teams to ensure seamless product launches and robust supply chain readiness. The ideal candidate brings strong supply chain knowledge, strategic sourcing expertise, supplier negotiations experience, and a demonstrated background in launching products within medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or other regulated industries.
Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage the New Products Supply Chain team, providing guidance, development, and performance feedback.

- Design and implement supply chain strategies for new product introductions, ensuring alignment with business goals.

- Coordinate closely with Product Development Engineering, Supplier Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure smooth product launches.

- Develop and monitor supply chain KPIs for new products and proactively address issues to achieve targets.

- Manage risk assessment and mitigation strategies regarding supplier selection, inventory planning, and logistics for new products.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain efficiency and responsiveness for new products.

- Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and all relevant regulations for new product supply and distribution.

- Communicate project timelines, risks, and mitigation actions to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Manage relationships with external partners, vendors, and suppliers to support new product launches.

- Prepare reports and analysis on supply chain performance and identify areas for improvement.
Qualifications:

Required Skills and Experience:
- Bachelor’s Degree Required (Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline preferred)

- 10+ years in supply chain management, strategic sourcing, or procurement within manufacturing (medical device, pharma, or regulated industry preferred)

- 1-2 years managing a small team of Supply Chain FTEs.

- Experience supporting product launches or new product introduction programs strongly desired

- Strong supplier negotiation, supplier development, and contract management skills

- Exceptional project management and cross-functional collaboration abilities

- Effective communicator—able to influence and build relationships at all levels, including executive and supplier partners

- High proficiency in data analysis, problem-solving, and supply chain systems/tools

- Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments with multiple priorities

Preferred Qualifications:
- Advanced degree (MBA, master’s in supply chain/Operations, or equivalent)

- APICS/ISM or similar supply chain certification

- Experience with global sourcing and supplier management

- Working knowledge of regulatory compliance (FDA, ISO, etc.) in medical device or pharma industries

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

A da Vinci® Area Sales Manager is responsible for selling the da Vinci® Surgical System to greenfield

and existing hospitals within the da Vinci® Area Sales Manager’s assigned territory. This requires a

number of capabilities including knowledge in the use of robotics, the ability to build a team of

advocates within each hospital, strong solution selling skills, and enough tenacity to insure sales

objectives are met on a consistent basis. da Vinci® Area Sales Managers are expected to provide an

extraordinary degree of information gathering and presenting to buying teams throughout the capital

equipment purchasing process.

Roles & Responsibilities:

• Manage the complex sales process of da Vinci® Surgical Systems into new hospitals and upgrades

into existing hospitals

• Build support from surgeons and administration for da Vinci® Surgery. Identify key institutions,

generate market awareness, and drive sales of the da Vinci® Surgical System within an assigned

sales territory

• Effectively manage transition of initial sale and installation to the sales team to drive procedural

volume and growth

• Achieve quarterly sales targets

• Partner with the da Vinci® Area Sales Director to develop a sales plan for their local territory

• Build surgical advocacy teams at each hospital

• Develop initial contact and relationship with CEO and senior hospital administrators

• Organize and manage the sales process

• Develop knowledge of primary OR procedures

• Make business case for system purchase

• Resolve contractual issues and coordinate system installation upon purchase approval

• Handle all communications and administrative follow-up
Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

Qualifications Required:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

• Minimum of 5 years sales experience preference for experience in healthcare or capital sales

• Knowledge of the operating room environment

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Proven successful track record in capital medical equipment sales

• Sales management experience a plus

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

• Ability to travel up to 50%, dependent upon account distribution

• Success in introducing new technologies to the market is a plus

jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner Commercial
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
The HR Partner is a client facing role that will work closely with Centers of Expertise (COE) and HR Business Leaders (HRBLs) to partner closely with business leaders and employees to provide high-touch, face to face support on key HR processes. The HR Partner will support teams to resolve complex issues and tasks, not handled by the People Services team because a greater level of care and support are needed. The HR Partner will utilize HR expertise plus geo/BU/ function-specific knowledge to solve talent-related problems, support leaders with recurring HR programs, and support special initiatives across the business.
Roles & Responsibilities:
- In collaboration with managers, build a positive employee environment that emphasizes Intuitive’s culture, core values, and individual and leadership expectations.
- Provide day to day support to HRBLs to support large groups while providing the right level of support at the right time.
- Actively partner with People Services team to successfully deliver on cyclical processes and support business needs.
- Act as a liaison between client groups and the employee relations and people services teams to escalate cases, identify areas of opportunity, provide constructive feedback and engage in effective solutioning when challenges arise.
- Service as connection point to COEs to customize solutions and programs, as needed, to meet business needs.
- Act as project lead for delivery of recurring HR services and core process (e.g., P&C process, Goal setting).
- Deliver expert coaching and consulting to senior management and employees to drive a high-performance culture.
- Build manager capability through coaching and facilitation of various training programs to build capability across client groups/regions.
- Provide guidance and coaching on HR & talent programs: merit, performance review, performance improvement, talent planning, talent development, succession planning, etc.
- Ensure delivery of a sustainable, consistent employee experience that is aligned with the HR strategy and employee value proposition. Escalate feedback to People Services teams, as needed.
- Understand business requests and strategize on the execution of these solutions with other HR leaders, as needed, to determine best solution and course of action.
- Continuously monitor performance of HR programs locally and be the voice of business with COEs providing real-time feedback, when needed.  Effectively articulate business requirements/needs to services and COE teams.
- Participate in various HR projects in recruiting, performance management, playbook development, programs and policies development and implementation, etc.
- Proactively leverage data and dashboards to assess trends, identify issues, themes and framing of data driven solutions for client groups supported.
- Acts as local “face of HR” for locations with large employee populations providing feedback and input when necessary and escalating issues, as needed.
- Leverage technology and defined process to deliver services globally.
Skills:
- This position will need to interact and influence all levels of the organization.
- As the voice of the business, this role will need to be able to influence both COE and People Service leaders.
- Proven ability to build trust and relationships with partners at various levels in the organization.
- Ability to exercise discretion, sound judgment, objectivity with the highest professional ethics, and always maintain confidentiality.
- Effective analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
- Data-driven and able to synthesize key insights
- Ability to simplify complex problems to provide clarity in driving resolution.
- Versatile and action-oriented; ability to manage projects from inception through to closure.
- Must be able to communicate in a clear and concise manner so the message easily translates across all areas of the organization.
- Ability to create and foster business relationships with leaders and employees across a range of functions and business groups
- Innovative and creative approach to problem solving.
- Accomplished organizational skills, including the ability to accomplish demanding timeline objectives.
- Must have the ability to work at strategic, operational, and tactical levels on a global scale.
- Strong facilitation and presentation skills
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build trust, credibility, and strong, productive relationships.
- Excellent organizational and project/program management skills.
- Familiarity and comfort in working in a highly matrixed organization.
- Ability to objectively coach employees and managers through complex, difficult, and emotional issues.
- High change agility.

Experience, Education, & Training:
- 8+ years of experience in Human Resources working in a Commercial environment
- 8+ years of experience in Human Resources in a client-facing role
- 8+ years of experience in an HR and/or COE role – working knowledge required to apply COE interventions
- 5+ years of experience working in a global and distributed work environment
- Experience working in a shared service environment, preferred
- Experience with project management
- Experience with organization transformation and integrations
- Bachelor’s degree in a business or HR-related field desired

- Locally relevant language, as required by geography

jobs.title: Endoluminal Sales Manager - UK
jobs.description:
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
As pioneer and leading company in the field of robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare’s hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere—we strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture—our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real-world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let’s advance the world of minimally invasive care.

An Endoluminal Sales Manager is responsible for selling the Ion Endoluminal System to greenfield and existing hospitals within the assigned territory. The role requires expert knowledge of diagnostic robotics, consultative and executive selling, the ability to build multidisciplinary advocacy teams, and the leadership to manage complex capital sales from opportunity identification through implementation. The Endoluminal Sales Manager serves as the strategic commercial lead for each opportunity, partnering cross-functionally to accelerate market adoption and deliver sustainable procedural growth.

- Manage the complete capital sales process from prospecting to contract signature and installation
- Develop territory and strategic account plans aligned with regional business objectives.
- Build executive, clinical and economic advocacy across C-suite, physicians, procurement and hospital administration.
- Lead executive presentations, business case discussions and value-based selling initiatives.
- Drive market development by identifying new accounts, clinical champions and key opinion leaders.
- Coordinate complex cross-functional deal teams including Clinical Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Finance, Legal, Service and Operations
- Support tenders, procurement processes and contract negotiations. Ensure smooth transition from capital sale to clinical implementation and procedural adoption.
- Maintain accurate CRM pipeline, forecasting and opportunity management.
- Travel extensively (approximately 70%)
Performance Objectives:
- Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Develop sustainable customer relationships across assigned territory.
- Create compelling financial and clinical business cases.
- Drive forecast accuracy and disciplined pipeline management.
- Expand market awareness and accelerate adoption of the Ion platform.
- Ensure successful implementation and long-term customer success.

- Minimum 5 years of medical device sales experience.
- Experience selling capital medical equipment preferred.
- Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
- Knowledge of bronchoscopy, endoscopy and/or operating room environments.
- Demonstrated strategic account management and complex stakeholder management.
- Ability to work cross-functionally within a matrix organization.
- Strong analytical, negotiation and business planning skills.
- Willingness to travel extensively.

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager MRO (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
The Sourcing Manager MRO will lead sourcing initiatives related to maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) as well aspects of research and development, to ensure Intuitive Surgical (Intuitive) secures services and products at optimal value. This role plays a pivotal part in driving innovation by supporting our internal teams. Key spend categories include R&D lab and other technical equipment, consumables, safety equipment and supplies (PPE), and preventative maintenance and calibration services. The individual will work closely with Intuitive's engineering teams, operations, and supplier quality departments.
The ideal candidate will possess the ability to conduct comprehensive supplier and category/market research, including market index analysis, data analysis, baseline development, RFP development, bid management, contract negotiations, offer analysis, and category strategy development. This role also involves post-bid management activities, such as contract and business reviews, spend analysis, and supplier management. Additionally, the candidate will manage multiple projects concurrently and support ad-hoc project requests.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Supplier Relationship Management:
- Build and sustain strong supplier partnerships to promote collaboration, trust, and mutual success.
- Act as the main liaison for suppliers concerning performance and strategic initiatives.
- Regularly review supplier performance, evaluate capabilities, and implement plans to boost performance and reliability.
- Set global standards to evaluate supplier performance and minimize business risks.

Strategic Sourcing:
- Independently manage the RFx or strategic sourcing process for complex projects, from initiation to completion.
- Analyze spending patterns and conduct market and supplier assessments to uncover cost-saving and innovation opportunities.
- Lead cross-functional teams to develop category strategies aligned with business goals and market trends.
- Optimize buying channels and create strategies for assigned spend categories, considering Procure to Pay (P2P) requirements.
- Provide comprehensive financial analysis for bid comparisons and alternative proposals.

Contract Management:
- Negotiate and manage supplier contracts, ensuring compliance with company policies and industry standards.
- Monitor contract performance and compliance with terms and conditions.
- Possess in-depth knowledge of terms and conditions included in MRO and related R&D contracts.
- Identify opportunities for contract optimization or consolidation to enhance cost efficiency and reduce risks.
- Secure favorable terms, quality, service compliance, and discounts while mitigating company risk.

Category Management:
- Establish a baseline for current spend categories and define future success criteria considering business goals and market conditions.
- Analyze market trends, risks, and potential new suppliers.
- Define key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the health of managed spend categories.
- Implement spend treatment plans for all levels of spend and risk within the category.
- Work with suppliers and stakeholders to execute the category strategy.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:
Required Skills and Experience
- 6+ years of experience, with at least 4 years in a strategic sourcing & category management role.
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree Required (Business, Supply Chain management, Finance, or related Discipline preferred).
- Proven experience working with suppliers and stakeholders for MRO categories.
- Exceptional negotiation skills, capable of guiding teams through complex and ambiguous situations.
- Strong conceptual thinking abilities to navigate and resolve intricate challenges.
- Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, suitable for engaging with team members and company leadership.
- Superior analytical skills to quickly assess situations, perform root cause analysis, and draw meaningful conclusions.
- Extensive experience in managing change across diverse stakeholder groups.
- Proven ability to influence senior leadership on strategic directions, value propositions, and sourcing recommendations.
- Strong skills in contract and vendor negotiation to secure favorable outcomes.
- Ability to build consensus and act as an impartial mediator to achieve sourcing objectives without compromising service quality or increasing risk/cost.
- Expertise in concurrently managing multiple projects and tasks, with a solid understanding of business requirements and project management methodologies.
- Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy with minimal supervision.
- Proficient in listening, understanding, and communicating effectively with employees at all levels.
- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within Intuitive and with suppliers.
- Fluency in German and English is required, any other European language will be a plus.
