jobs.title: Sourcing Director, APAC
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Sourcing Director, APAC will define and lead the regional sourcing strategy for Intuitive Surgical, ensuring alignment with global sourcing objectives while driving innovation, cost optimization, and operational excellence across APAC. This role will oversee strategic sourcing initiatives for indirect categories such as construction, facilities management, professional services, and logistics, delivering measurable value and mitigating risk. The Director will partner

with senior business leaders to influence decisions that shape Intuitive’s growth in the region.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing Leadership
- Develop and execute a regional sourcing vision and roadmap aligned with global sourcing strategy.
- Lead complex, high-value sourcing projects across APAC, ensuring competitive advantage and compliance.
- Drive innovation and supplier collaboration to support business growth and operational excellence

Stakeholder Engagement
- Act as a trusted advisor to APAC leadership, influencing strategic decisions on sourcing priorities.
- Partner with global sourcing teams to ensure consistency and alignment with global category strategies.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Operations, and Facilities.

Supplier Strategy & Performance
- Establish and maintain strategic supplier partnerships to enable innovation and resilience.
- Oversee supplier performance governance, risk management, and compliance across APAC.
- Anticipate market trends and proactively adjust sourcing strategies to maintain cost efficiency and mitigate risks.

Financial & Operational Impact
- Deliver measurable cost savings, risk reduction, and operational improvements through strategic sourcing.
- Provide executive-level reporting on sourcing performance, market insights, and strategic initiatives.
Required Skills & Experience
- 15+ years of experience, with at least 10 years in sourcing leadership roles.
- Proven track record of leading regional or global sourcing strategies in complex, multi- country environments.
- Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills at executive level.
- Strong change management experience, driving sourcing transformation across diverse cultures and geographies.
- Expertise in strategic negotiations, contract governance, and supplier relationship management.
- Ability to shape sourcing strategy, not just execute projects.

Education
- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Language
- Fluent in English; proficiency in an Asian language is a plus.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position
• A da Vinci Area Sales Manager is responsible for selling the daVinci™ Surgical System to
greenfield hospitals and existing hospitals within the Area Sales Manager’s assigned territory.
• This requires a number of capabilities including expert-level knowledge in the use of surgical
robotics, the ability to build a team of advocates within each hospital, strong solution selling
skills, and enough tenacity to ensure sales objectives are met on a consistent basis.
• Da Vinci Area Sales Managers are expected to provide an extraordinary degree of
information gathering and presenting to buying teams throughout the capital equipment
purchasing process.
Essential Job Duties
• Manage the complex sales process of daVinci Surgical Systems into new hospitals and upgrades into existing hospitals
• Build clinical and administrative support through technical presentations, executive meetings, marketing events and system test drives.
• Build support from surgeons and administration for da Vinci® Surgery.
• Identify key institutions, generate market awareness, and drive sales of the daVinci™ Surgical System within an assigned sales territory.
• Effectively manage transition of initial sale and installation to the clinical sales team to drive procedural volume and growth.
• Achieve quarterly sales targets.
• Partner with the da Vinci Area Sales Director to develop a sales plan for their local territory.
• Build surgical advocacy teams at each hospital.
• Develop initial contact with CEO and senior hospital administrators.
• Organize and manage the sales process.
• Develop expert level knowledge of primary OR procedures.
• Make business case for system purchase.
• Resolve contractual issues and coordinate system installation upon purchase approval.
• Handle all communications and administrative follow-up.
Required Skills and Experience:
• Relevant work experience of at least 8 years in Medical Devices sector. Experience in

equipment / capital sales is preferred.

• Knowledge of the operating room environment

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Proven successful track record in capital medical equipment sales.

• Ability to travel up to 50%, dependent upon account distribution.

• Fluent in English and local language as required.
Required Education and Training:

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
• MBA from a premier business school preferred
Working Conditions:

None
Preferred Skills and Experience:

• Sales management experience a plus

• Success in introducing new technologies to the market is a plus.

jobs.title: Clinical Sales Director
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The da Vinci Clinical Sales Director plays a critical role in building and developing the da Vinci surgical programs in his/her territory.  He/She is responsible for developing and executing the short and long-term territory strategy and to manage the da Vinci Clinical Sales Managers. This will include growing and managing procedures within the assigned region, expanding existing programs with new technology and the hiring, training, and development of a dynamic Intuitive Sales Team.
Promote the Intuitive culture, cultivating a positive work environment and fostering cohesive team dynamics that empower employees to thrive and contribute to our collective success.

Essential Job Duties (Specific responsibilities and tasks an individual would be expected to perform in the role. Additional job duties may be determined by functional people manager)

- Business: - Drive sales by analyzing territories, structuring sales quota goals, and setting revenue expectations to achieve market objectives. Forecast sales and manage quarterly and annual quota targets.
- Align with CSM/SSM for quarterly P&R to achieve Sales Win Goals.
- Manage expenses within the budget.
- Oversee the sales process of da Vinci® Surgical Systems into new hospitals and upgrades in existing hospitals.
- Develop and implement sales activities to exceed organizational goals.
- Diagnose, write, and execute plans to reach clinical and new product goals.
- Build close, trustful relationships with key decision-makers in surgery and hospital management.
- Lead and support SFDC utilization across the team.
- Drive MDEs on focus specialty and surgeon.
- Own BAM to Hospital C-Level.

- Strategic Planning: - Responsible for strategic planning and execution in alignment with the GM, e.g., LRM3.
- Review and track GOST and regional goals status, steering IST growth and success.
- Prioritize and manage the launch of new products across different territories.
- Work with the Marketing team on focus procedure events, KOLs, Case Observation Sit, etc.

- People Development: - Assist managers in Implementing quarterly sales skills for team development.
- Build a highly motivated Sales Team by hiring, training, developing, and retaining top talent to drive adoption of da Vinci surgery.
- Lead and manage a fast-growing and changing organization, executing a hiring plan to meet growth targets.
- Provide coaching and development across the organization to develop future leaders and stronger salespeople.
- Collaborate with the Commercial Learning and Marketing teams to educate Sales teams on new and existing product information.

- Assist the Managers in: - Negotiating key accounts and further developing KOLs.
- Clinical sales presentations and organizing territories.
- Building country-specific clinical and economic validation of da Vinci Surgery.
- Closing deals, sales presentations, and developing end-user business plans.
Required Skills and Experience (Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that an individual must possess in order to successfully perform in job)
- Minimum 10+ years in Sales/Business Development, with minimum of 5 years in sales/marketing management, including managing managers.
- Proven track record in managing and developing a high-performing sales force in the healthcare industry.
- Experience in surgical and/or operating room settings.
- Results-oriented. A proven track record of setting objectives and delivering results.
- Ability to lead and motivate teams to embrace visions and changes.
- Strong focus on key priorities and effective operation in a dynamic environment.
- Strong business acumen and market knowledge.
- Capacity and desire to learn new technology independently.
- Excellent communication skills in English and the local language as required.
- Comprehensive understanding of the business beyond one's own area, including products/services and financial aspects.
- Ability to build productive working relationships with co-workers and external parties.
- Skilled in managing conflict and negotiations.
- Involves others, listens actively, and builds commitment.

Required Education and Training (As applicable - Specific education and training that an individual must possess in order to successfully perform in job)

- Minimum Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a medical-related field preferred.

jobs.description:
About the Role:
The manager, New Products Supply Chain is a critical leadership role that leads the team that oversees supply chain operations for the launch of new products. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence by collaborating with cross-functional teams, optimizing processes, and ensuring timely, cost-effective supply of innovative products to market.

The Manager, New Products Supply Chain, will lead end-to-end supply chain activities for new product introduction (NPI) initiatives, driving innovation, speed-to-market, and operational excellence within a highly regulated industry. This manager will oversee sourcing, procurement, and supplier management activities for new product components and assemblies.
Responsibilities include building cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory teams to ensure seamless product launches and robust supply chain readiness. The ideal candidate brings strong supply chain knowledge, strategic sourcing expertise, supplier negotiations experience, and a demonstrated background in launching products within medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or other regulated industries.

- Develop and monitor supply chain KPIs for new products and proactively address issues to achieve targets.
- Manage risk assessment and mitigation strategies regarding supplier selection, inventory planning, and logistics for new products.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain efficiency and responsiveness for new products.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and all relevant regulations for new product supply and distribution.
- Communicate project timelines, risks, and mitigation actions to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Manage relationships with external partners, vendors, and suppliers to support new product launches.
- Prepare reports and analysis on supply chain performance and identify areas for improvement.

- Bachelor’s Degree Required (Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline preferred)

- Strong supplier negotiation, supplier development, and contract management skills
- Exceptional project management and cross-functional collaboration abilities
- Effective communicator—able to influence and build relationships at all levels, including executive and supplier partners

- Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments with multiple priorities

jobs.title: Speciality Sales Manager Benign General Surgery
jobs.description:
Primary Function:
The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in identifying, developing, and expanding adoption of da Vinci procedures in Benign General Surgery across North + East India. Partnering with Sales Leadership and teams in Clinical Sales, Capital Sales, Key Accounts, Marketing, Professional Education, Market Access, and other relevant functions, the SSM will develop specialty growth strategies, build surgeon and institutional champions, strengthen field competency, and support sustainable robotic surgery programs.
This is a senior, strategic field role focused on procedures that can drive future growth. It combines clinical selling, market development, surgeon pathway execution, customer value creation, and cross-functional program leadership. The SSM will work through the local commercial organization and directly engage priority customers where specialist expertise is required.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedure Utilization
•  Develop and execute the India specialty strategy for Benign General Surgery, aligned with regional priorities and commercial objectives.
•  Identify and prioritize procedure growth opportunities, including hernia repair, cholecystectomy, and other relevant benign general surgery procedures within the specialty.
•  Apply established da Vinci adoption and procedure readiness methodologies in assigned specialties, territories, and target accounts.
•  Analyze procedure, surgeon, account, and market trends to prioritize opportunities, address adoption barriers, and guide field execution.
•  Partner with local Clinical Sales and Capital Sales teams to develop account-specific plans that increase utilization of installed systems and create future system opportunities.
•  Lead strategic market development activities that build awareness, clinical confidence, and sustainable procedure adoption.
2. Convert High-Volume Laparoscopy Centers into da Vinci Programs
•  Identify and prioritize high-volume laparoscopic centers in Benign General Surgery that have the clinical leadership, procedure volume, infrastructure, and strategic intent to build a robotic surgery program.
•  Develop conversion strategies that articulate the clinical, operational, and economic value of da Vinci surgery to surgeons, hospital executives, and other decision-makers.
•  Partner with Capital Sales, Clinical Sales, Key Accounts, and hospital stakeholders to help qualified high-volume laparoscopic centers procure a da Vinci system and establish a sustainable program.
•  Support the complete program-building journey, including opportunity assessment, executive alignment, surgeon onboarding, care-team readiness, initial case-series support, patient pathway development, and post-launch growth planning.
3. Develop Surgeons, KOLs, and Centers of Excellence
•  Identify and develop surgeon champions and Key Opinion Leaders for priority procedures in partnership with Marketing and Professional Education.
•  Create development plans for high-potential surgeons from initial adoption through sustainable utilization, advanced procedure adoption, teaching capability, and peer influence.
•  Collaborate cross-functionally to establish suitable case observation sites, proctors, training centers, and peer-learning platforms.
•  Coordinate appropriate case observation, on-site support, simulation or laboratory learning, advanced training, and peer-to-peer education in accordance with approved processes.
•  Bring relevant clinical and workflow value during the initial surgeon case series and support continuous improvement as experience develops.
•  Develop and lead regional specialty education and market development programs that can scale adoption.
4. Build Clinical, Operational, and Economic Value
•  Work with surgeon champions, care teams, and internal partners to identify and develop credible clinical, operational, and economic value evidence.
•  Understand customer success measures within the operating room and across the patient pathway, and translate them into account-specific value discussions.
•  Partner with relevant internal functions to develop value-focused steering committees, executive reviews, and customer action plans.
•  Conduct hospital, department, and practice executive presentations that support informed decision-making and program expansion.
•  Use approved evidence, customer data, and value tools responsibly and in accordance with company policy.
5. Elevate Specialty Sales Competency
•  Coach, counsel, and train Clinical Sales representatives and managers on Benign General Surgery anatomy, procedure pathways, customer needs, clinical value, and consultative selling approaches.
•  Provide field feedback that strengthens representatives’ ability to engage Benign General Surgery specialists and position applicable advanced technologies.
•  Identify area-level capability gaps and coordinate competency-building programs with Clinical Sales Directors and other relevant leaders.
•  Create practical field tools, talk tracks, account-planning guidance, and best-practice sharing to improve execution consistency.
•  Model high-quality clinical selling and influence through joint field visits, customer engagements, and opportunity reviews.
6. Lead Cross-Functional Initiatives and Market Intelligence
•  Serve as the market intelligence liaison for Sales, Marketing, Professional Education, and Training teams by providing timely insights on customers, competitors, procedure trends, adoption barriers, and unmet needs.
•  Leverage specialty resources to support scalable launches of new procedures, products, advanced technologies, and customer programs.
•  Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.
•  Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.
•  Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.
•  Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.
Skills/Job Requirements:
•  Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market-development experience.
•  Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.
•  Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.
•  Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.
•  Proven ability to influence peers and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
•  Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.
•  Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret market, procedure, surgeon, and account trends.
•  Knowledge of the operating room environment and a solid clinical foundation to understand healthcare value.
•  Ability and willingness to travel extensively across India, including overnight travel, based on business needs.
•  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Indian languages is advantageous.
•  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required.
•  Relevant postgraduate qualification in business, healthcare, life sciences, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in minimally invasive surgery, robotic-assisted surgery, benign general surgery, hernia, cholecystectomy, or surgical capital equipment.
•  Experience developing surgeon champions, KOLs, case observation sites, training programs, or centers of excellence.
•  Experience building a new clinical market, converting established surgical practices, or launching a hospital program.
•  Previous people-management experience or demonstrated readiness for broader leadership responsibility.
•  Experience working with large hospital groups, academic institutions, or complex accounts in India.

•  Align with Sales Leadership and Marketing on surgeon training resources, training effectiveness, procedure volume outcomes, and advanced technology adoption.
•  Collaborate effectively in a complex matrix organization and influence decisions without direct authority.
•  Responsibly manage company resources and budgets to support strategies with the strongest commercial and customer impact.
•  Maintain accurate and timely documentation of plans, activities, opportunities, and outcomes in approved company systems.
Skills/Job Requirements:
•  Minimum 8 years of relevant medical device, surgical, clinical sales, or healthcare market-development experience.
•  Proven track record of individual sales excellence and successful introduction or adoption of new technologies.
•  Strong clinical selling capability and the ability to build credibility with surgeons, hospital executives, and highly educated customer groups.
•  Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, prioritize opportunities, and deliver results in an environment of change.
•  Proven ability to influence peers and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
•  Effective communication and presentation skills across a broad organization and diverse customer audiences.

jobs.title: Clinical Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

This position will be responsible for development and execution of strategic and tactical clinical

marketing initiatives to drive da Vinci procedure adoption within Taiwan market. The individual will be

expected to collaborate with external stakeholders such as dV KOLs and society leaders as well as

internal stakeholders such as sales, marketing, training, clinical affairs, market access and health

economics teams.

Essential Job Duties

• Spend time in the field with customers and sales teams to learn the nuances of different surgical

specialties, procedures and practices, Surgeon learning journey, patient journeys and

customer/hospital priorities.

• Using qualitative and quantitative resources, understand our customers and their environment

deeply. Perform segmentation, persona development, targeting and messaging (clinical, economic,

operational, strategic) that will allow us to connect with targeted customer segments effectively.

• In close collaboration with sales and other commercial functions, develop/refresh annual marketing

plans that outline objectives, strategies & tactics that support da Vinci adoption in focus procedures.

Build the necessary clinical marketing events, programs and collateral. Deliver on the expected

KPIs.

• Develop and cultivate existing/new KOLs by targeted specialties and segments. Collaborate with

them for effective Peer-to-Peer events. Conduct formal and informal surgeon advisory boards to

incorporate their feedback into our marketing strategies and tactics.

• Incubate KOL and develop KOL program to support surgeons accelerate DV journey

• In collaboration with dV KOLs, propagate the WHY and the HOW behind Intuitive ecosystem for da

Vinci platforms to generate demand from other surgeons for new trainings or expanded use.

• Work with surgeons to develop clinical evidence on key metrics to demonstrate the clinical,

efficiency or economic value of Da Vinci Surgery

• Understand the competitive environment and develop differentiation positioning, messaging and

tactics to establish Intuitive as the preferred choice of our customers.

• Build relationships with key society members/leadership to establish a higher level of engagement

to ensure Intuitive is seen as an integral partner for surgeon education, surgical guidelines and

evidence generation.

• Highly integrate clinical marketing initiatives with the product marketing, Hospital Marketing and

marketing communication peers for optimal development of messages, collaterals and society

booth engagements.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and KOLs in developing marketing strategies, tactics and

collateral for new expansion procedures and surgical techniques
Required Skills and Experience

• At least 7 years of sales & marketing experience in healthcare industry required

• Proven ability to develop and implement surgeon-facing marketing strategies and tactics

• A proven track record of achievement, execution-oriented

• Demonstrated ability to execute multiple priorities simultaneously

• Strong executive presence and communication skills required

• Interpersonal skills to work across different functions

• Positive attitude and perseverance against headwinds

• Above-average verbal and written English required

• Must be well versed in MS Office Suite

Required Education and Training

• Minimum Bachelor degree required, Master degree preferred

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Product/procedure experience in a medical device or surgical field company strongly preferred

jobs.title: da Vinci Specialty Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in driving identification and adoption of new procedures for the da Vinci surgical system. Partnering with sales leadership and staff in Clinical Sales and Capital Sales, including marketing and Market Access. The Specialty Sales Manager will identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders to pioneer and expand use of the da Vinci system in surgical specialties in early stages of growth.
They will also partner with local sales representatives to coach, counsel, and train them on selling to specialists in their assigned hospital accounts. This is a unique and strategic role for a senior level sales professional across the assigned territory who is focused on identifying and expanding the adoption of targeted procedures that will drive the future growth of Intuitive.
Roles and Responsibilities
This position has the responsibility and authority to:

Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedures Utilization
- Develop Key Opinion Leader (KOL) for surgical specialty, including Colorectal, General Surgery, Thoracic, GYN, Hernia , and with potential further expansion towards other clinical indications
- Develop existing customers to potentially become case observation sites & Epicenters
- Through collaboration with sales leadership and marketing, conduct strategic market development activities
- Implement Consolidation Pathway Methodology
- For KOLs, execute all sales activities in support of developing their proficiency as a da Vinci surgeon. These activities include: - Select appropriate case observation site
- Conduct on-site and wet lab training
- Bringing value in first series of cases
- Bring intra-operative & post-operative clinical value in initial surgeon case series
- Develop and lead advanced regional training programs
- Implement new technology

- Serve as the market intelligence liaison for marketing and training teams
- Conduct hospital and practice executive presentations
- Develop future training pipeline by developing existing surgeons into new indications or converting strategic new target to the da Vinci technology.

Elevate Area Specialty Sales Competency
- Provide feedback to enhance representatives’ ability to sell to specific specialties
- Identify area needs, coordinate and run competency programs with support from the regional CSM and Clinical Sales Director

Manage Key Initiatives
- Leverage Specialty Sales resources to help scale launch of new procedures and/or products
- Align with Sales leadership and marketing to manage surgeon training resources related to: - Utilization
- Training effectiveness
- Procedural volume outcomes

- Analyze and affect targeted specialty procedure trends; exploit anomalies and manage appropriately
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree required
- 5+ years of medical device sales required
- Track record of individual sales excellence
- Excellent clinical selling skills and ability to quickly build credibility with a highly educated customer base
- Strong clinical knowledge across multiple surgical specialties, especially Colorectal, General Surgery, GYN, Thoracic, Hernia.
- Demonstrated ability to manage complexity and work in an environment of change
- Proven ability to influence peers
- Effective communication skills across a broad organization with a variety of focuses
- Fluent in local language & English
- Overnight travel required 2-3 days / week (70%).

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager MRO APAC
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Strategic Sourcing Manager MRO (reporting to Director Sourcing, APAC) will lead sourcing initiatives

for indirect spend categories related to maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) as well aspects of

research and development, to ensure Intuitive Surgical (Intuitive) secures services and products at optimal

value. This role plays a pivotal part in driving innovation by supporting our internal teams. Key spend

categories include R&D lab equipment, consumables, safety equipment and supplies (PPE), and

preventative maintenance and calibration services. The individual will work closely with Intuitive's

engineering teams, operations, and supplier quality departments. This role will additionally support other

indirect procurement spend categories such as facilities, real estate, construction, utilities, workplace

services, professional services, and warehousing, storage, and logistics services. The precise split of these

categories across the APAC indirect procurement team may be refined as the team structure evolves. As

this role will serve as a greenfield position at a facility under construction, it requires a candidate with

experience establishing procurement operations from the ground up — including standing up supplier

relationships, building category baselines, and supporting site readiness activities ahead of and during

facility launch.

Given Intuitive's standing as a regulated medical device company, the candidate must be comfortable

navigating compliance requirements that intersect with MRO procurement — including calibration

standards, PPE/safety regulations, and documentation practices aligned with quality and regulatory

expectations.

The ideal candidate will possess the ability to conduct comprehensive supplier and category/market

research, including market index analysis, data analysis, baseline development, RFP development, bid

management, contract negotiations, offer analysis, and category strategy development. This role also

involves post-bid management activities, such as contract and business reviews, spend analysis, and

supplier management. Additionally, the candidate will manage multiple projects concurrently and support

ad-hoc project requests.

1. Supplier Relationship Management:
- Build and sustain strong supplier partnerships to promote collaboration, trust, and mutual success.
- Act as the main liaison for suppliers concerning performance and strategic initiatives.
- Regularly review supplier performance, evaluate capabilities, and implement plans to boost performance and reliability.
- Set global standards to evaluate supplier performance and minimize business risks.
- For the greenfield site: proactively identify, qualify, and onboard new suppliers in the APAC region ahead of facility launch, establishing relationships where no incumbent base exists.

2. Strategic Sourcing:
- Independently manage the RFx or strategic sourcing process for complex projects, from initiation to completion.
- Analyze spending patterns and conduct market and supplier assessments to uncover cost-saving and innovation opportunities.
- Lead cross-functional teams to develop category strategies aligned with business goals and market trends.
- Optimize buying channels and create strategies for assigned spend categories, considering Procure to Pay (P2P) requirements.
- Provide comprehensive financial analysis for bid comparisons and alternative proposals.
- Support greenfield site readiness by executing sourcing activities on accelerated timelines, coordinating with facilities, operations, and engineering to meet site launch milestones.

3.Sourcing Operations & Pipeline Management:
- Manage sourcing intake by receiving, evaluating, and triaging stakeholder requests across the APAC site.
- Prioritize sourcing requests based on business urgency, spend impact, and strategic alignment, operating within the Indirect Procurement governance model.
- Maintain visibility of the sourcing pipeline — tracking active projects, upcoming RFx activity, and contract renewals — and communicate status to key stakeholders and procurement leadership.
- Operate within established Indirect Procurement governance frameworks, ensuring consistency in process, approvals, and reporting across the region.

4. Contract Management:
- Negotiate and manage supplier contracts, ensuring compliance with company policies and industry standards.
- Monitor contract performance and compliance with terms and conditions.
- Possess in-depth knowledge of terms and conditions included in MRO and related R&D contracts.
- Identify opportunities for contract optimization or consolidation to enhance cost efficiency and reduce risks.
- Secure favorable terms, quality, service compliance, and discounts while mitigating company risk.

5. Category Management:
- Establish a baseline for current spend categories and define future success criteria considering business goals and market conditions.
- Analyze market trends, risks, and potential new suppliers.
- Define key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the health of managed spend categories.
- Implement spend treatment plans for all levels of spend and risk within the category.
- Work with suppliers and stakeholders to execute the category strategy.
- Contribute to and track savings targets — including cost savings and cost avoidance — aligned with Indirect Procurement goals; provide regular reporting on savings performance to procurement leadership.
Required Skills and Experience
- 6+ years of experience, with at least 4 years in a strategic sourcing & category management role.
- Proven experience working with suppliers and stakeholders for MRO categories.
- Experience working within a regulated industry (e.g., medical devices, life sciences, aerospace), with the ability to navigate compliance requirements that intersect with procurement activities.
- Greenfield or site-launch experience — demonstrated ability to build procurement operations, supplier bases, and category frameworks from the ground up.
- Exceptional negotiation skills, capable of guiding teams through complex and ambiguous situations.
- Strong conceptual thinking abilities to navigate and resolve intricate challenges.
- Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, suitable for engaging with team members and company leadership.
- Superior analytical skills to quickly assess situations, perform root cause analysis, and draw meaningful conclusions.
- Extensive experience in managing change across diverse stakeholder groups.
- Proven ability to influence senior leadership on strategic directions, value propositions, and sourcing recommendations.
- Strong skills in contract and vendor negotiation to secure favorable outcomes.
- Ability to build consensus and act as an impartial mediator to achieve sourcing objectives without compromising service quality or increasing risk/cost.
- Experience managing sourcing intake, prioritizing requests, and maintaining pipeline visibility within an indirect procurement governance model.
- Expertise in concurrently managing multiple projects and tasks, with a solid understanding of business requirements and project management methodologies.
- Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy with minimal supervision.
- Proficient in listening, understanding, and communicating effectively with employees at all levels.
- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within Intuitive and with suppliers.

Required Education and Training
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree Required (Business, Supply Chain management, Finance, or related discipline preferred)
- Languages: English, Malay. Any other Asian language will be a plus.

jobs.title: Network Security Operations Center Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position: We are seeking a motivated and proactive Network Security and Operations Center Operations Supervisor to join our dynamic team in a full-time role with opportunities for growth based on performance and organizational needs. This role is responsible for ensuring 24/7 operational coverage, managing performance metrics and KPIs, scheduling shifts, and fostering a collaborative team environment. The supervisor will play a key role in maintaining the security and integrity of essential operations, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and driving operational excellence.
Essential Job Duties
- Ensure 24/7 staffing coverage for cybersecurity operations, managing recruitment, onboarding, and retention of analysts to meet operational needs.
- Develop, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, such as incident response times, alert resolution rates, and system uptime.
- Create and manage shift schedules to maintain continuous monitoring, balancing team workloads and accommodating employees requests with business needs.
- Collaborate with cybersecurity, network engineering, and leadership teams to align operational goals.
- Communicate performance updates, incident summaries, and staffing needs clearly to stakeholders through reports and briefings.
- Conduct performance evaluations, identify training needs, and support professional development for team members.
- Maintain compliance with cybersecurity policies and frameworks
Required Skills and Experience
Qualifications:
- Experience: Previous experience in a cybersecurity, network monitoring, or security operations role is preferred. Familiarity with incident response procedures and network protocols is highly desirable.
- Technical Skills: Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles, network environments, and network monitoring tools. Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) systems is a plus.
- Collaboration: Strong ability to work independently and as part of a team, with excellent communication skills to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills and a meticulous approach to documenting incidents, following processes, and meeting deadlines.
- Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced setting.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Team Leadership: Proven experience leading or supervising technical teams, including mentoring analysts, assigning tasks, and conducting performance evaluations.
- Shift Management: Ability to manage 24/7/365 operations, including coordinating shift schedules and ensuring proper staffing coverage.
- Decision‑Making Under Pressure: Strong ability to make timely, high‑impact decisions during security incidents or outages.
- Training & Development: Ability to upskill team members, deliver training sessions, and promote a learning culture.

Required Education and Training
- Education: A degree or certification in cybersecurity such as SANS, information technology, or a related field is preferred but not required with demonstrated experience.
- Strong English Written and Verbal Communication Skills - The ideal candidate must demonstrate exceptional proficiency in both written and verbal English communication. This includes the ability to:
- Clearly and concisely articulate ideas in meetings, presentations, and discussions.
- Produce well structured, grammatically accurate written materials such as reports, emails, and documentation.
- Adapt communication style based on audience—technical, non-technical, leadership, or cross functional teams.
- Actively listen, ask clarifying questions, and provide thoughtful responses.
- Communicate complex or technical concepts in a simplified and approachable manner.
- Maintain professionalism and clarity in both synchronous and asynchronous communication channels.

Working Conditions
- None

Preferred Skills and Experience
- Knowledge of SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, ArcSight) or network monitoring platforms.
- Exposure to cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or MITRE ATT&CK.
- Familiarity with critical infrastructure systems or industrial control systems (ICS) is a plus.
- A passion for cybersecurity and a proactive mindset in identifying and mitigating risks.

jobs.title: Senior Trade Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Senior Logistics Compliance Analyst is responsible for the import and export

compliance procedures and international trade programs, which include but not

limited to supply chain security (C-TPAT, AEO), international trade data integrity

(country of origin, classification, ECCN, etc), duty drawback, Free Trade

Agreement, reconciliation, etc. This position will assist Logistics Compliance

manager in driving the overall logistics compliance strategies, activities, and

requirements for the medical devices import, export, and trade regulations. He/

she will ensure compliance with applicable company policies and regulations

while ensuring the expeditious flow of international trade. This individual will

support the organization at a tactical and operational level and advises

management on strategics initiatives.

Essential Job Duties
Import & Export Trade Compliance
- Perform import/export activities in compliance with government regulations, organizational policies, procedures, goals, and objectives.
- Manage compliance with preferential and non-preferential trade programs and issue certificates as applicable.
- Submit and monitor import/export permit and license applications as needed.
- Provide import and export compliance training to cross-functional teams.
- Support global and regional compliance projects and programs.

Customs, Tariffs & Regulatory Programs
- Manage issues related to: - Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification
- Country of Origin determinations
- Customs valuation
- Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCN)
- Anti-dumping regulations
- Duty drawback and duty suspension programs
- Other governmental programs providing import/export exemptions

- Oversee Customs reconciliation and anti-boycott programs.
- Manage Miscellaneous Tariff Bill activities, including product eligibility reviews and petition filings.
- Monitor global trade policy developments and regulatory changes, including Section 301 tariffs.
- Support Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) implementation and annual validation activities.

Regulatory Research & Business Support
- Research customs and regulatory requirements for new destination markets, including: - Product classifications
- Import licenses
- Customs valuation
- Documentation requirements
- Import and export restrictions

- Communicate regulatory requirements and impacts to business stakeholders.
- Provide support to company sites, suppliers, and customers to strengthen compliance programs and capabilities.

Data Management, Systems & Process Improvement
- Audit and maintain trade compliance data governance within SAP, product databases, and compliance record systems.
- Partner with IT and the Center of Excellence (COE) to improve import/export compliance data and system capabilities.
- Define business requirements, support testing activities, and assist with implementation of compliance solutions.
- Assist in the development and maintenance of operational processes and procedures to improve workflow efficiency and compliance effectiveness.

Compliance Programs, Audits & Risk Management
- Conduct internal risk assessments and report findings.
- Develop and monitor Compliance Improvement Plans.
- Create and maintain: - Trade compliance manuals
- Policies and procedures
- Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
- Compliance guidelines

- Assist in developing Intuitive audit guidelines to: - Monitor customer and order compliance
- Identify compliance risks
- Determine future training and procedural needs

Reporting & Performance Management
- Develop and generate compliance metrics, management reports, and service provider performance reports.
- Analyze compliance program effectiveness and communicate results to management.

Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration
- Communicate company policies and procedures to internal and external stakeholders.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to support compliance initiatives and business objectives.
- Perform additional duties, special projects, and responsibilities as assigned.
Qualifications & Skills
- Expert knowledge of:
- Customs regulations
- FDA import regulations
- Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
- U.S. Census trade requirements

- Strong knowledge of:
- Import and export classification
- Free Trade Agreements (FTAs)
- Customs compliance training

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, including:
- Risk management
- Gap analysis
- Regulatory compliance assessment

- Proven ability to:
- Manage and drive change
- Evaluate data and identify issues
- Develop innovative solutions using existing resources
- Interpret and implement regulatory requirements appropriately

- Demonstrated success delivering practical and creative solutions to:
- Complex logistics challenges
- Current and emerging regulatory compliance issues

- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to:
- Multi-task effectively
- Manage competing priorities
- Make consistent decisions and follow through
- Work independently with minimal guidance

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including:
- Oral and written communication
- Facilitation and stakeholder engagement
- Cross-functional partnership and influence

- Experience managing multiple cross-organizational projects and working effectively with all levels of an organization

- Experience with:
- Supply Chain Security Programs
- Duty drawback processes
- Customs compliance programs

- Proficient in:
- Microsoft Outlook
- Word
- Excel
- PowerPoint

- Strong research, analytical, interpersonal, and time management skills

- Team-oriented with flexibility to support a variety of projects

- Willingness to travel up to 10%

Education & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Finance, or a related field

- 7+ years of experience in:
- Trade Compliance
- Logistics Operations Compliance
- Medical Device industry compliance

- Licensed U.S. Customs Broker or equivalent professional trade compliance certification preferred

Preferred Skills & Experience
- Experience implementing and maintaining Global Trade Management (GTM) software
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA and related transactional processes and reporting
- Prior customs compliance experience preferred

Working Conditions
- None specified.

jobs.title: Sr Analyst, Supply Chain Risk & Network Visibility
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Sr. Analyst, Supply Chain Risk & Network Visibility is responsible for building and advancing

visibility into supplier-held inventory and upstream supply chain networks to support supply chain

risk management, inventory optimization, and operational decision-making. This role will establish

structured data, analytics, and governance frameworks to ensure accurate and actionable

insights into supplier inventory positions and commitments. The analyst will also support the

development of supplier and sub-tier mapping capabilities to enhance supply chain transparency

and compliance. In addition, this role will provide advanced analytics and modeling to support

broader supply chain initiatives, including risk mitigation, inventory strategy, and master data

governance.
Essential Job Duties

• Develop and maintain a centralized dataset capturing supplier-held inventory (finished

goods and raw materials), including contractual requirements and inventory commitments
Assess and rationalize current supplier inventory data

sources (e.g., APIs, iValua feeds, manual reporting),

identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for

standardization

• Design and implement standardized frameworks and best

practices for supplier inventory reporting, visibility, and governance

• Build analytics, dashboards, and reporting to monitor supplier inventory attainment,

coverage, and alignment to contractual expectations and planning assumptions

• Partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Planning, Sourcing, IT, and Data teams to

improve data quality, integration, and governance related to supplier inventory and

master data

• Support the development and maintenance of supplier and part-site mapping (Tier-1),

including key attributes such as COO, AML, and manufacturing locations

• Support the implementation and scaling of a sub-tier supply chain mapping capability,

including evaluation of tools, development of data intake processes, and establishment of

governance for ongoing maintenance

• Perform advanced analytics and modeling to support supply chain risk management,

inventory strategy, and operational decision-making
Required Skills and Experience

• 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, analytics, or a related field, with

exposure to areas such as inventory management, supplier management, or supply

chain risk

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with large, complex

datasets and translate data into actionable insights

• Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power

BI) to support reporting, modeling, and decision-making

• Familiarity with supply chain systems and data structures (e.g., ERP systems such as

SAP, supplier management platforms like iValua, or similar tools)

• Ability to assess data quality, identify gaps, and drive improvements in data governance,

standardization, and process design

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively with

stakeholders across Supply Chain, Planning, Sourcing, IT, and Finance

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly present analytical findings and

recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences

Required Education and Training
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management,

Operations, Business Administration, Engineering,

Finance, Analytics, Economics, or a related quantitative

or technical field
Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with supplier network visibility, supply chain mapping, or multi-tier supply

chain analysis, including tools or platforms such as Everstream Analytics, Altana,

Prewave or similar

• Prior experience working with or integrating supplier data sources (e.g., APIs, EDI,

supplier portals) to enable real-time or near real-time visibility

• Background in inventory strategy, planning, or materials management, including concepts

such as safety stock, coverage, and lead time variability

• Experience supporting or building data models and governance frameworks for supply

chain or master data (e.g., part-site, COO, AML structures)

• Familiarity with supply chain risk management (SCRM) concepts, including supplier risk,

disruption monitoring, and scenario analysis

• Experience with advanced analytics or modeling techniques (e.g., Python, R, or statistical

modeling) to support decision-making

• Exposure to cross-functional or enterprise systems transformations (e.g., ERP

implementations, supplier platform migrations, or data architecture initiatives

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

Under the supervision of the Finance Manager, Europe, the Finance Analyst is responsible for executing standardized financial processes supporting month-end and quarter-end close cycles, data consolidation, and reporting activities.

The role primarily supports European financial operations and reporting by consolidating financial and commercial data from multiple sources to produce accurate and timely recurring deliverables. This includes supporting monthly accruals, close activities, and reporting processes. The Finance Analyst also contributes to process optimization, basic data visualization, and ad-hoc business support, ensuring data is well-structured, reliable, and efficiently produced.

Roles and Responsibilities:

- Prepare recurring consolidated reporting packages (weekly, monthly, quarterly) covering financial and commercial performance metrics, with a focus on accuracy, efficiency, and scalability
- Assist in building and maintaining BI dashboards; support ad-hoc analysis requests with clear, structured, and professional data presentation
- Prepare and manage monthly accruals (e.g., open POs, commissions, recurring costs) using multiple data sources; support the development and maintenance of models to improve calculation accuracy
- Analyze variances (budget vs. actual) across operating expenses, headcount, and key commercial metrics, identifying and explaining primary drivers
- Work with financial systems (e.g., ERPs, planning tools) to consolidate, structure, and upload data accurately
- Support continuous process improvement through documentation, standardization, and automation of financial workflows
- Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented mindset by identifying issues, proposing improvements, and independently driving resolution
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, data science or other related fields
- 3-6 years of experience in finance operations, accounting, or shared services environment
- Basic understanding of accounting principles (e.g., accruals, journal entries, general ledger)
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data handling, reconciliation, templates)
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organizational and time management skills, especially under tight deadlines
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English
Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience :

- Experience supporting month-end close processes in multinational organization
- Familiarity with reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, ect)
- Exposure to ERP Systems (SAP, Oracle, ect)
- Exposure to process documentation and continuous improvement

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Position’s Objective & Summary:
The Senior Financial Analyst serves as a strategic business partner to the Korea leadership team by providing financial planning, business analytics, performance reporting, and decision support.
This role is responsible for supporting forecasting, budgeting, long-range planning (3-year planning horizon), management reporting, and business performance analysis while partnering closely with Commercial teams.
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with business acumen to translate complex data into actionable insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.
This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Finance, Business Planning, Commercial Analytics, and Executive Decision Support within a fast-growing healthcare technology organization.
Key Roles and Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis
- Lead annual Budget, Forecast, and Long Range Management (LRM) processes

- Prepare and coordinate detailed departmental budgets and monthly/quarterly forecasts

- Perform variance analysis and identify business risks and opportunities

- Monitor operating expenses and support cost management initiatives

- Participate in month-end close activities in partnership with Accounting teams

- Ensure financial reporting accuracy and address reporting-related inquiries from Corporate, APAC, and business stakeholders

- Support investment planning and resource allocation decisions through financial analysis and business modeling

Commercial Analytics & Business Performance
- Develop and maintain business performance dashboards, KPI frameworks, and management reporting packages

- Monitor key business metrics including procedures, system placements, utilization, productivity, and commercial performance

- Support customer ROI analysis, benchmarking, and business case development

- Maintain and enhance business analytics tools to support Commercial teams

- Participate in business review meetings and provide analytical insights to support strategic decision-making

- Translate business performance trends into actionable recommendations for leadership teams

Reporting, Automation & Business Intelligencess
- Collaborate with Corporate FP&A and regional Finance teams to develop and enhance reporting solutions

- Lead monthly closing, quarterly forecast, annual budget, and LRM reporting processes and coordinate communication with Corporate Finance teams

- Improve reporting efficiency through automation and process simplification

- Develop Tableau dashboards and analytical tools to improve business visibility and decision-making

- Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting governance across business functions

Cross-functional Partnerships
- Build strong working relationships with Commercial, Marketing, and all enabling stakeholders

- Serve as a trusted business partner by providing proactive insights and recommendations

- Support strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects through analytical and financial expertise

- Contribute to continuous process improvement and operational excellence initiatives

- Effectively communicate financial and business insights to leadership teams and key stakeholders
Qualifications
Required
- Minimum 7+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Planning, Commercial Analytics, Sales Analytics, Consulting, or related functions

- Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities

- Experience interacting with regional and global stakeholders in a matrix organization

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

- Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, SAP, Anaplan, Power BI, or similar tools

- Experience working with large datasets and business reporting tools

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

- Fluent in Korean and English

Preferred
- Experience supporting commercial organizations and business leadership teams

- Healthcare, Medical Device, Life Sciences, Technology, or Consulting industry experience

- Experience developing dashboards, business intelligence solutions, or analytical tools

- Customer-facing analytical support or business consulting experience

- Experience supporting commercial organizations and business leadership teams

jobs.title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Governance Analyst with expertise in SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) and experience integrating master data processes across Agile PLM and SAP S/4HANA systems. The ideal candidate will play a key role in defining, governing, and optimizing master data processes that support manufacturing and supply chain operations, product lifecycle management, and enterprise data quality programs. The candidate should seek out and recommend process improvements, assist in developing team member data knowledge and governance skill sets, and take on strategic initiatives that support enterprise scale of systems and governance processes. The candidate should drive root cause investigation to remediate issues and implement short and long-term objectives for continuous improvement across multiple stakeholder departments. This position requires deep knowledge of SAP material master, thorough understanding of manufacturing operations through global facilities, and holistic business operations impact from interconnected systems and data. This role requires strong analytical skills and clear communication abilities to both tactical and leadership levels.
Key Responsibilities:
- Lead business analysis for master data management initiatives focused on Agile PLM, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP MDG.
- Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to define data governance processes, ownership, and data stewardship models with a focus on material (product) master data.
- Gather and document business requirements, process flows, and functional specifications for product master data domain.
- Support design and implementation of SAP MDG solutions for data creation, validation, approval workflows, and integration with downstream systems.
- Harmonize Agile PLM with SAP MDG/S4 to ensure consistent product and material master data synchronization across platforms.
- Perform impact analysis and coordinate with cross-functional teams (Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Quality, and IT) to ensure master data consistency and accuracy.
- Develop and maintain documentation for data models, governance rules, and business processes.
- Support data migration, data cleansing, and enrichment activities during system transitions, upgrades, and business scale.
- Provide functional support for master data-related issues and change requests.
- First point of contact and champion for data quality and governance best practices, ensuring alignment with corporate data strategy and compliance requirements.
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or MDM specialist in an SAP environment.
- Hands-on experience with SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) — configuration, workflows, data models, and validation rules.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA data structures, particularly in supply chain, materials management, MRP, production planning, and product master lifecycle management.
- Solid understanding of supply chain operations, including sourcing, manufacturing, planning, and logistics data flows.
- Proficiency in documenting business processes, data flows, and functional specifications.
- Advanced MS Office skills, understanding of vlookup, pivot tables, macro recordings, data tables, charting, and formula auditing
- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with data governance frameworks and data quality tools.
- Familiarity with integration and analytic technologies: SAP PI/PO, BRF+, tableau, Advanced Planning Systems (O9), MES, AI/machine learning.
- Exposure to MDM migration projects or S/4HANA transformation programs.
- Knowledge of PLM (Agile) to ERP (SAP) integration, MES (SAP ME), and IBP (o9).
- SAP MDG certification or SAP S/4HANA certification preferred.

jobs.title: Compliance Specialist 2
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Safety Control Specialist is responsible to insure timely post-marketing filings (GVP) and complaint

handling filings. Maintain post marketing and complaint handling documentation with necessary filings

and communications to appropriate parties. Communicate with government / regulatory agencies on a

local basis. Support the quality management activity in cooperation with QA team. Prepare and

maintain SOP for post-marketing filing, complaint handling and quality management.
Roles and Responsibilities:

 Preparation and implementation of GVP in compliance with Japanese PAL.

 Collection and first reviewer of local and overseas post-marketing safety information.

 Complaint handling management for filings and prepare the customer letter.

 Communication with head office on complaint cases for preparation of customer letter.

 Support quality management activity and work with QA team to maintain the appropriate quality management system.

 Prepare and maintain the appropriate SOP for post-marketing filing, complaint handling and quality management in a timely manner.

 Continuous improvement and management of the safety/quality assurance process in accordance with Intuitive Surgical Product Development Process.

 Work directly with regulatory agencies on safety/quality issues and submissions.

 Documentation of Package Insert and PMDA web maintenance of Package Insert

Skill/Job Requirements:

 Educated and trained for post-marketing and/or quality management duties.

 Excellent ability to work in cross-functional environments.

 Strong verbal and written communication skills, proven ability to translate technical documentation into effective regulatory documents.

 3-5 years’ Experience working directly with the MHLW and other governmental agencies on Post marketing matters and/or Quality assurance matters.

 Friendly, positive attitude which fosters cooperation.

 Careful documentation of every step in a field action.

 Careful follow up of information sent to users and regulatory agencies.

 Understanding of Japan and international regulations regarding medical device safety / quality management.

jobs.title: Financial analyst
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position :
The Financial Analyst will be a member of the FP&A department that supports the European manufacturing & service sites, currently Freiburg, Biebertal & Parvomay. The job owner will be involved in further developing and standardizing the controlling and reporting tools to support effective decision-making of our business partners.
Roles and Responsibilities :
- Preparation, tracking, analysis and reporting of monthly and quarterly financials for the European manufacturing & service sites as part of month-end, quarter-end, forecast and budget cycles
- Develop and maintain relationships with regional site leaders and their teams
- Drive quarterly expense, capital and headcount forecasts and annual budget processes in close cooperation with business partners
- Perform active cost controlling by reviewing and approving purchase requisitions and headcount requests in accordance with budget commitments, identify risks & opportunities & agree on trade-offs with business partners
- Preparation of target-performance analyses / variance analysis as well as development of recommendations for future actions and strategies
- Perform yearly standard cost roll process for the European manufacturing & service sites
- Continuous improvement and streamlining of current FP&A processes
- Prepare ad-hoc financial reports or analysis
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience :
- Successfully completed bachelor´s degree (Master’s degree preferred) in business studies or similar, ideally with a focus on Finance, Accounting and Controlling
- Written and verbal fluency in English
- At least 4 years of relevant work experience in the field of controlling / financial planning & analysis
- Experience in a production environment
- Knowledge of international accounting (US-GAAP) is a plus
- Good knowledge of SAP
- Experience with financial planning and reporting systems; Tableau, Anaplan and SQL are a plus
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in MS Excel, structured thinking, curiosity
- High level of integrity, commitment, and ethics
- Good energy level and active participation in improving the business (from a financial perspective) based on data analysis
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, structured work approach

jobs.title: Financial Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Job Description
Primary Function of Position
At Intuitive, Financial Analyst Interns work on meaningful projects that support business decisions, improve processes, and create lasting impact. Interns are embedded within a finance team, partnered with an experienced mentor, and given ownership of work that contributes to real business outcomes. Interns lead a summer capstone project and present recommendations to Finance leadership.
Essential Job Duties
- Perform financial and operational analyses supporting planning, forecasting, budgeting and decision making.

- Develop reports, dashboards and data visualizations using financial and operational data.

- Conduct business case, ROI and cost-benefit analyses.

- Identify process improvement and automation opportunities.

- Collaborate, as needed, with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain and Commercial teams.

- Lead a capstone project and present findings to leadership.
Required Skills and Experience
- Superb analytical skills and experience working with data (wrangling, cleaning, summarizing, tec.), including at least one major quantitative research project desired (e.g. stats or econometrics term papers)

- Excellent attention to detail

- Ability to communicate effectively (written, oral)

- Excellent interpersonal skills including a collaborative work style

- Deep desire to learn and acquire new skills

- Self-motivated, curious, and comfortable with ambiguous challenges

- High integrity with the ability to handle confidential information and data appropriately

- Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

- 3.0+ GPA (please list on resume)

- Authorization to work in the US is a prerequisite for employment

- Sponsorship of work visa is not available

University Hiring Program Eligibility Requirements:
- University Enrollment: Must be currently enrolled in and returning to an accredited degree-seeking academic program in the Fall.

- Internship Work Period: Must be available to work full-time (approximately 40 hours per week) during a 10-12 week period starting May or June. Specific start dates are shared during the recruiting process.

Required Education and Training
- Current enrollment and completion of at least two years of an undergraduate program in finance, business administration, accounting, economics, or related field prior to internship.

Working Conditions None
Preferred Skills and Experience
- Accounting coursework

- Minor in data analytics, statistics

- Experience with Tableau and SQL

jobs.title: da Vinci Specialty Sales Manager - France (localisation flexible)
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:
The Specialty Sales Manager plays a critical role in driving identification and adoption of new procedures for the da Vinci surgical system. Partnering with sales leadership and staff in Clinical Sales and Capital Sales, including marketing and Market Access. The Specialty Sales Manager will identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders to pioneer and expand use of the da Vinci system in surgical specialties in early stages of growth.
They will also partner with local sales representatives to coach, counsel, and train them on selling to specialists in their assigned hospital accounts. This is a unique and strategic role for a senior level sales professional across the assigned territory who is focused on identifying and expanding the adoption of targeted procedures that will drive the future growth of Intuitive.
Roles and Responsibilities
This position has the responsibility and authority to:

Expand da Vinci Specialty Procedures Utilization
- Develop Key Opinion Leader (KOL) for surgical specialty, including Colorectal, General Surgery, Thoracic, GYN, Hernia , and with potential further expansion towards other clinical indications
- Develop existing customers to potentially become case observation sites & Epicenters
- Through collaboration with sales leadership and marketing, conduct strategic market development activities
- Implement Consolidation Pathway Methodology
- For KOLs, execute all sales activities in support of developing their proficiency as a da Vinci surgeon. These activities include: - Select appropriate case observation site
- Conduct on-site and wet lab training
- Bringing value in first series of cases
- Bring intra-operative & post-operative clinical value in initial surgeon case series
- Develop and lead advanced regional training programs
- Implement new technology

- Serve as the market intelligence liaison for marketing and training teams
- Conduct hospital and practice executive presentations
- Develop future training pipeline by developing existing surgeons into new indications or converting strategic new target to the da Vinci technology.

Elevate Area Specialty Sales Competency
- Provide feedback to enhance representatives’ ability to sell to specific specialties
- Identify area needs, coordinate and run competency programs with support from the regional CSM and Clinical Sales Director

Manage Key Initiatives
- Leverage Specialty Sales resources to help scale launch of new procedures and/or products
- Align with Sales leadership and marketing to manage surgeon training resources related to: - Utilization
- Training effectiveness
- Procedural volume outcomes

- Analyze and affect targeted specialty procedure trends; exploit anomalies and manage appropriately
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree required
- 5+ years of medical device sales required
- Track record of individual sales excellence
- Excellent clinical selling skills and ability to quickly build credibility with a highly educated customer base
- Strong clinical knowledge across multiple surgical specialties, especially Colorectal, General Surgery, GYN, Thoracic, Hernia.
- Demonstrated ability to manage complexity and work in an environment of change
- Proven ability to influence peers
- Effective communication skills across a broad organization with a variety of focuses
- Fluent in local language & English
- Overnight travel required 2-3 days / week (70%).
- This position can be based anywhere in France.
